news.impact: Lawrence had a fantastic game against the Titans' woeful defense. He's been in MVP form for some time now, and the Jaguars are rolling. He has had at least three touchdowns in three of his last four games, and he will get to face the Giants next weekend.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also ran once for -1 yard.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence throws for 242 yards in rainy TNF
news.impact: Lawrence didn't have to do much to get his team the win in this game, much like Sunday when he faced the Colts. His one touchdown came on a breakaway play by Parker Washington, who was quiet aside from that play. Lawrence gets another easy matchup next week against the Titans. They will be well rested, however, as Tennessee is on a bye, but the Jaguars have a mini-bye themselves thanks to the Thursday game.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions
news.impact: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon. The Jags' ringleader averaged 21 yards on his 10 completions, connecting with seven different receivers. Lawrence added 10 yards on three carries and did not throw an interception. He did lose a fumble, but that was his only real blemish. Lawrence has completed 65.7% of his throws this season, averaging over 240 yards with an impressive 17-4 TD/INT ratio through seven games.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24-of-41 passes for 306 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in a 34-31 loss to Houston. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence tosses four touchdowns in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Lawrence and the Jaguars' offense turned heavily to the passing game in the second half after falling behind Houston early. Lawrence was able to top 300 yards passing for the second straight game and set a new season high in passing attempts. Lawrence and the Jaguars will head to a bye in Week 7.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 25-of-35 pass attempts for 187 yards, one touchdown, and one interception. He added 25 rushing yards and one fumble on six carries.
news.head: Tyler Shough accounts for two turnovers in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Shough led the team in rushing in Sunday's loss, but had a costly fumble that led to a Panthers' touchdown. Shough will look to bounce back in Week 11, but will be taking on a tough Bears' defense on the road.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 21-of-35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also ran 10 times for 51 yards.
news.head: Tyler Shough goes for 265 yards in win over Browns
news.impact: Shough had two fumbles in this game as well, but both were recovered by the offense. He didn't throw a pick, but he took five sacks. So it was a bit so-so in real life, but for fantasy, he did just fine and was boosted by his 51 rushing yards. He could be an interesting QB option next week against the Panthers.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards, a touchdown, and a pick in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He was the Saints' leading rusher with seven yards on three carries.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws for 278 yards in loss
news.impact: Shough didn't have a terrible game, all things considered. He was accurate, put up decent yardage, but was just held out of the end zone. Obviously, that's a big part of fantasy football, but it's also important to remember that because the Saints had no running game, it made things a little tougher for Shough in the passing game.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Shough continues to play through broken bones in his non-throwing hand. After a slow start in the first quarter, he had a solid afternoon the rest of the game. He also added another touchdown on the ground. He'll face the Steelers next week.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed 11 times for 47 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in his only target for eight yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. reaches end zone in Week 10 win over Packers
news.impact: Jones Sr. has cooled off out of the backfield of late, recording under 100 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust while sharing backfield work with Jordan Mason for the Vikings ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. gained 16 yards on five carries and caught his only target for five yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. gets just six touches on Monday night
news.impact: Jones' paltry production in this one wasn't the result of backfield mate Jordan Mason seeing a surge in touches, as the latter finished with just seven of his own. The Vikings' offense is all out of sorts at the moment, and their RB tandem is suffering as a result. Jones looked like he might have found the Fountain of Youth earlier this season, but over the last three weeks, the veteran has given fantasy managers next to nothing.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed five times for 22 yards while also catching both of his targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. held in check in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Jones Sr. has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, rushing for less than 30 yards in each of his last two contests. The running back faces another stiff test against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Jones returned to practice on Thursday and Friday. He will be an RB2/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Alvin Kamara rushed for four yards and a touchdown on two carries in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 10 yards and a touchdown.
news.head: Alvin Kamara finds the end zone in Week 10
news.impact: It was a low volume day for Kamara, but he made the most of it with two touchdowns. His role was considered up in the air with Travis Etienne returning and Audric Estime playing well, but the veteran was able to produce when it mattered Sunday. Kamara and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11 .

news.body: Alvin Kamara is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Kamara will be good to go in his passing down role in the Saints backfield.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Kamara was held out of the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, but he made his return to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be a full go in Week 10 but will see less work than usual if Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is back in the lineup this week.

news.body: Alvin Kamara was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara not seen practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Kamara usually has his practice reps managed early in the week. He should still be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty ran for 18 yards on nine carries in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 46 yards receiving.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty totals 64 yards from scrimmage Sunday
news.impact: Jeanty was once again shut down on the ground. The majority of his yardage on the day came on a catch and run for 38 yards. He remains a borderline RB2 play for fantasy managers right now.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty ran for 25 yards on six carries in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers. He also caught 5-of-7 targets for -5 yards receiving.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty totals 11 touches Sunday
news.impact: Jeanty led Las Vegas in rushing on the day with 25 yards. Mike Washington Jr. also saw six carries. Based on his role the past two games, Jeanty is solely a risky RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed for nine yards on two carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 64 yards.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty sees just two carries in Week 8 win
news.impact: Jeanty saw the bulk of the rushing attempts go to Mike Washington Jr. in the win Sunday. After the game, it was made clear that this was the plan and was communicated to Jeanty prior to the game. Fantasy managers will want to monitor reports from the Raiders heading into Week 9.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed eight times for 15 yards while also hauling in all eight of his targets for 61 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty finds end zone in Week 7 loss to Rams
news.impact: Jeanty has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a touchdown in each of the last two contests. The second-year running back will look to take advantage of an inconsistent New York Jets offense in Week 8.

news.body: Bam Knight ran for 19 yards on five carries in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
news.head: Bam Knight runs for 19 yards Sunday
news.impact: Making his return from the concussion protocol, Knight and Tyler Allgeier both saw five carries in the blowout loss. They will be tougher to trust in lineups splitting the work on what is currently a not very good offense.

news.body: Bam Knight will play in Week 10 against the Rams after clearing concussion protocol.
news.head: Bam Knight clears concussion protocol, will play Sunday
news.impact: Knight was able to log a full practice on Thursday. He'll likely return to a committee with Tyler Allgeier in the Cardinals backfield with Carson Beck making his debut.

news.body: Bam Knight was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bam Knight (concussion) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Knight is on track to return for Sunday's game against the Rams. He'll likely form a committee again with Tyler Allgeier in the Cardinals backfield.

news.body: Bam Knight resumed practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Bam Knight (concussion) returns to practice Wednesday
news.impact: Knight remains in concussion protocol. If he gets cleared in time for Sunday, he'll figure to return to his committee role alongside Tyler Allgeier in the Cardinals backfield.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Tuten will be good to go for Sunday's game, despite missing some practice this week due to a couple of nagging lower-body issues. He should be a full go against the Giants and will remain a high-quality fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
news.impact: Tuten was not able to practice on Thursday after being limited by a pair of injuries at Wednesday's practice. This may very well be nothing more than an injury management move on the part of the team, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't be concerned with his availability for Week 11, unless he still has an injury designation heading into the weekend.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Tuten is dealing with a couple of nagging injuries right now and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. He has been playing through them and producing well recently, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't have any concerns for his Week 11 outlook at this point.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten ran 26 times for 88 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday. He also caught three of four targets for 25 yards.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten runs for 88 yards in win over Titans
news.impact: Tuten was by far the Jaguars' leading rusher in this game, with RB2 Chris Rodriguez having a mere five yards on four carries. It was a nice bounce-back from last week's performance, and he should be a solid starter the rest of the way.

news.body: Bijan Robinson carried the ball 16 times for 71 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for six yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Bijan Robinson reaches end zone in Week 10 loss to Chiefs
news.impact: Robinson was one of the few bright spots in the Atlanta offense Sunday, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in nine of 10 games. The running back remains locked in as a reliable RB1 option in all formats entering the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed for 100 yards and a touchdown on 19 carries in a 34-17 loss to the Flacons. He caught 6-of-7 targets for 47 yards.
news.head: Bijan Robinson eclipses 100 rushing yards in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Robinson dominated the backfield touches for the Falcons and was able to account for 147 total yards in the loss. Robinson will look to continue his strong season in Week 10 against Kansas City.

news.body: Bijan Robinson ran for 76 yards on 19 carries in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson runs for 76 yards Sunday
news.impact: Robinson did not catch his lone target. It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. Bijan remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed for 63 yards on 20 carries and caught all five of his targets for 59 yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson gains 122 yards of total offense in Week 7 win
news.impact: Robinson finished with just over 60 yards on the ground for the second straight week, but he nearly doubled his offensive output with his efforts in the passing game. Robinson hasn't visited the end zone since Week 4, and fantasy managers hope that will change in a Week 8 matchup with the Buccaneers. Robinson remains one of the top overall fantasy assets despite this short dry spell.

news.body: Blake Corum ran for 100 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for 19 yards receiving.
news.head: Blake Corum runs for 100 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kyren Williams got the start for the Rams per usual, but Corum wound up being the hot hand on the day in the Rams backfield. He also added three receptions on the day. He remains a steady RB2 for fantasy managers, especially with the Rams wide receiver room banged up.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed 11 times for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
news.head: Blake Corum hits paydirt in win
news.impact: Despite having four carries fewer than fellow running back Kyren Williams, Corum outproduced Williams by 13 yards on the ground. Corum started the season as a high-end handcuff, but now is a high floor RB3/Flex play weekly. Corum will look to continue this momentum in Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Blake Corum leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Corum played well on Sunday. He led the team with 73 yards over the course of the game, and he was able to do that while maintaining an efficient clip of 6.6 yards per carry. His touchdown was the cherry on top, and fantasy managers should expect him to continue to see considerable work moving forward, even while sharing the backfield with Kyren Williams.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed 17 times for 93 yards and one touchdown while also catching his only target for eight yards in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Blake Corum reaches end zone in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Corum has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording one touchdown in each of his last three contests. The dynamic running back remains an impactful option behind No. 1 running back Kyren Williams for head coach Sean McVay, with a Week 8 matchup against the winless Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 40 yards on eight carries in a 31-12 loss to the Bills. He caught his lone target for six yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen sees nine touches in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Allen took a backseat to Breece Hall for the second straight week since Hall's return to the lineup. Allen remains a handcuff at best heading into a Week 11 matchup with the Chargers.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 33 yards on eight carries in the Jets' 35-12 loss to the Chiefs. He caught both of his targets for 21 yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen sees 10 touches in Week 9
news.impact: Allen saw the return of Breece Hall to the lineup for the first time since Week 3. Allen has three 100 yard performances with Hall sidelined with a quad injury, but immediately saw his usage take a dip with Hall's return. Allen will likely remain the backup to Hall heading into a Week 10 matchup with Buffalo.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 147 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen excellent in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Allen set a new career high in rushing yards and has been excellent as the starting running back with Breece Hall (quad) out for the fifth straight game. Allen has tallied over 100 rushing yards in three of those five games and will likely remain a key part of the Jets' offense in Week 9 against the Chiefs.

news.body: Braelon Allen (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Braelon Allen (ankle) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Allen will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report earlier in the week due to an ankle injury. He should be a full go in Week 8 and will be New York's primary running back if Breece Hall (quad) is unable to suit up against the Raiders.

news.body: Breece Hall rushed for 41 yards on 11 carries in a 31-12 loss to the Bills. He caught all four of his targets for 67 yards.
news.head: Breece Hall sees 15 touches in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Hall continued to lead the Jets' backfield in his second game since returning from injury. Fantasy managers should expect Hall to continue to lead the backfield in Week 11 against the Chargers.

news.body: Breece Hall rushed for 61 yards on 15 carries in a 35-12 loss to the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 26 yards.
news.head: Breece Hall leads Jets' backfield in Week 9
news.impact: Hall made his return from a quad injury that has kept him out of action since Week 3. Braelon Allen returned to the backup role, seeing eight rushing attempts to Hall's 15. Hall and the Jets will take on the Bills in Week 10.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Hall is now off of the injury report entirely heading into the weekend, meaning that he is fully good to go and will make his return to the lineup on Sunday. He still has explosive week-to-week potential, but he may be more inconsistent moving forward now that Braelon Allen has earned more touches for himself while serving as the team's temporary RB1.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Hall was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He told reporters that he will be ready to play in Week 9, so fantasy managers should expect to see him out on the field on Sunday, barring any unforeseen setbacks between now and then.

news.body: Bucky Irving carried the ball 20 times for 97 yards and two touchdowns while catching four of his five targets for 28 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Bucky Irving scores two TDs in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Irving scored on rushes of two and six yards in the close loss, giving him five touchdowns over his past three games. The veteran running back has been one of the few bright spots on a disappointing Tampa Bay offense this season, posting 825 rushing yards and eight all-purpose touchdowns in nine contests. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Bucky Irving explodes for 170 yards Sunday
news.impact: It was the Irving and Kenneth Gainwell show all afternoon as Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. Irving saw career-highs in both carries and yardage. He also had a second touchdown taken away on a fumble at the goal line. He'll be a borderline RB1 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Bucky Irving did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (rest) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: It was a rest day for Irving. He should be back at practice on Friday.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran 24 times for 106 yards and two touchdowns in the Bucs' 43-13 win over Carolina. He also caught one of two targets for four yards.
news.head: Bucky Irving gashes Carolina in win
news.impact: Irving has put up strong performances of late, with 100+ rushing yards and 1+ rushing touchdowns in two of his last three games played. He's firmly in RB2 territory with RB1 upside.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) logs another full practice Thursday
news.impact: To no surprise, Skattebo was again a full participant on Thursday, which means that his hamstring injury is almost a non-issue at this point. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 11.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: Skattebo was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday. He previously missed time with a hamstring issue, but he played through it and looked great last week, so it's unlikely to be an issue for him moving forward. He will continue to be a good fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Cam Skattebo carried the ball 18 times for 78 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of his four targets for 44 yards on Thursday night in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Cam Skattebo scores two TDs in Week 10
news.impact: Skattebo missed the previous game with a hamstring injury but he was a difference-maker for the Giants in Week 10. The second-year runner found on the end zone twice, on runs of one and 13 yards. Skattebo has run for 496 yards and four touchdowns while catching 14 passes for 120 yards in eight games this year. He will be an RB2 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) is good to go for Thursday night's game against the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) good to go for Thursday
news.impact: Skattebo missed last week's game due to a hamstring issue he's still managing, but he is off of the injury report and expected to be good to go for Thursday night's matchup. Fantasy managers should expect him to start and see a lot of work in this big divisional game against the Commanders.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball 10 times for 44 yards and caught 8-of-9 targets for 39 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Chase Brown scores twice in win Sunday
news.impact: Brown finally had an explosive game on Sunday night. He racked up 83 total yards on the night and was able to get into the end zone twice through the air, which left him with a fantastic fantasy total. This should give fantasy managers confidence that he will be a good option over the back half of the season, although he still seems prone to some bad performances on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed for 57 yards on nine carries in a 34-17 win over the Falcons. He caught all three of his targets for 18 yards.
news.head: Chase Brown sees 12 touches in Week 9 win
news.impact: Brown continues to see his impact on the Bengals' offense diminish with Joe Burrow and the passing attack being extremely effective over the last few weeks. Samaje Perine did see more carries than Brown, but the bulk of that was late in the game. Brown and the Bengals will take on the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Chase Brown carried the ball 12 times for 55 yards while catching eight of his nine targets for 46 yards and losing a fumble in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Chase Brown catches eight passes in Week 8
news.impact: Brown did most of his damage in the passing game in the thrilling win over Tennessee. More importantly, he out-touched Samaje Perine 20-to-five in the contest after Perine had been cutting into his workload in recent weeks. Brown will continue to be a low-end RB1/high-end RB2 as he prepares to face the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed for 39 yards on 11 carries in a 35-13 win over the Ravens. He caught 4-of-5 passes for 19 yards.
news.head: Chase Brown sees 15 touches in Week 7 win
news.impact: Brown continues to struggle in the running game and saw Samaje Perine get the goal line carry that resulted in the Bengals' lone rushing touchdown. Brown has not eclipsed 50 rushing yards since Week 3 and has failed to find the end zone since Week 1. Brown and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey carried the ball 13 times for 62 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all four of his targets for 161 yards and two touchdowns in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey explodes for over 200 offensive yards in Week 10 win
news.impact: McCaffrey continues an explosive stretch out of the San Francisco backfield, posting one or more touchdowns in each of his last eight games. The running back remains a dynamic RB1 option in all formats entering a Week 11 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for 19 yards receiving and another score.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey totals two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey was able to dominate in another big role for the 49ers. He remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Cowboys.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) is expected to see his full workload Sunday according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) expected to see full workload Sunday
news.impact: McCaffrey looks to not have any limitations entering Sunday’s Week 9 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders, offering head coach Kyle Shanahan one of his more dynamic playmakers as part of a San Francisco offense ravaged by injuries entering Sunday.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) is off of the injury report for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers according to Nick Wagoner.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) off injury report for Week 9
news.impact: McCaffrey is good to go once again while fighting through a lingering hamstring issue for head coach Kyle Shanahan, lining up the dynamic running back for another sizeable workload against a generous Raiders defense Sunday.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 92 yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries in a 20-17 win over the Saints. He caught all five of his targets for 80 yards.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard hits pay dirt twice in Week 10 win
news.impact: Hubbard found the end zone on runs of one and two yards to pace the Panthers to victory. He also led the team in receptions and receiving yards. Hubbard will look to build on his strong performance in Week 11 against Baltimore.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed 16 times for 79 yards while catching four of five targets for 17 yards in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard rushes for 79 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Hubbard averaged 4.9 yards per carry and accounted for 16 of Carolina's 20 rushing attempts. More importantly, he handled 20 touches while the Panthers' other running backs combined for just two carries. The workload is there, even if the touchdowns weren't. Hubbard remains Carolina's primary running back heading into Week 10 against New Orleans.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 81 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding 38 yards on seven receptions in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard gains 119 yards, scores in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Hubbard delivered a true workhorse effort Thursday night and was certainly one of the main reasons the Panthers hung around until the end of this contest. Hubbard is having a strong season through seven games, averaging 20 touches for close to 100 yards of offense. He has also found the end zone in five of those games.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard ran seven times for 33 yards and caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to Tampa Bay on Sunday.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard saved by receiving work in loss to Tampa
news.impact: Hubbard was actually fairly efficient on the ground, the game just got away from Carolina so quickly that he didn't receive many touches. He was greatly helped by his receiving work in PPR formats, with his four receptions tied for the most on the team. He will look to have a better night against the Packers on Thursday.

news.body: The Eagles released RB Dameon Pierce.
news.head: Dameon Pierce released by Eagles
news.impact: Pierce was released with an injury settlement.

news.body: The Eagles placed RB Dameon Pierce on injured reserve.
news.head: Dameon Pierce placed on IR
news.impact: Pierce becomes the latest Eagles running back to go down with an injury. He'll miss at least the next four weeks.

news.body: Dameon Pierce rushed the ball 14 times for 47 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Dameon Pierce finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Pierce saw the most carries on the team on Monday night, with Saquon Barkley (hamstring) still having a limited workload in his return game. Barkley seems to have gotten banged up in this game as well, so if he's out next week, Pierce will prove to be startable in a lot of league formats in a matchup against the Commanders on Sunday night next week.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles running back Dameon Pierce carried the ball 12 times for 35 yards and a score and caught four passes for 15 yards in a loss to the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Dameon Pierce scores in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Pierce made his first start since 2023 with Houston. Saquon Barkley is recovering from a hamstring injury, and Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are both on injured reserve, which could make Pierce the starter for another week or two. He is likely to be a touchdown-dependent FLEX option in an offense missing several pieces, though he dominated the backfield touches in Week 6.

news.body: D'Andre Swift carried the ball 12 times for 31 yards and failed to catch his lone target in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: D'Andre Swift runs for 31 yards in Week 9 win
news.impact: Swift was quiet in the win just one week after scoring three touchdowns. The veteran running back has 576 rushing yards and 10 touchdowns in nine games this season. A strong RB1 in fantasy this season, Swift will be on bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Saints.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed the ball 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns while adding two catches for ten yards through the air in Monday night's 24-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: D'Andre Swift scores three touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: Swift pulled off the hat trick on Monday night, getting into the end zone three different times in a big win over Seattle. Outside of that he wasn't very efficient and didn't get a lot of work as a receiver, so while his fantasy total was very good, it didn't quite reach dominant levels. He should continue to be a high-end fantasy asset moving forward with how good this Chicago offense looks right now.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed for 78 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding four receptions for 12 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: D'Andre Swift finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: With Kyle Monangai (thumb, toe) still out and Roschon Johnson not very involved, Swift shouldered a workhorse load against the Patriots on Thursday night. The dual-threat back averaged less than 3.5 yards per touch, but he did find the end zone for the seventh time this season, which has him currently tied for second in the NFL in rushing touchdowns. Swift will go up against the Seahawks' defense in Week 8. He remains a low-end RB1 for standard fantasy leagues.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in four of his five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone twice in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Swift continues an impactful stretch out of the Chicago backfield, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in each of his six contests. The running back will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

news.body: David Montgomery gained 107 yards on 26 carries, adding 17 yards on three receptions in Thursday's 26-3 rout of the Colts.
news.head: David Montgomery goes over 100 yards in return
news.impact: So much for easing back in after a four-game absence, as Montgomery got 29 touches in an impressive workhorse effort Thursday night. The veteran back went over 100 yards for the first time this season, and he looks plenty primed for the stretch run. Montgomery is right back in the RB2 range for standard formats.

news.body: David Montgomery (groin) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: David Montgomery (groin) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: Montgomery has been out for a handful of weeks while recovering from a groin issue of some kind, but he is finally ready to make his return to the lineup and is off of the injury report ahead of Thursday night's game. Unless the team indicates that he will have limited snaps, fantasy managers should expect him to be a viable option in this great matchup against the Colts, especially with Woody Marks (concussion) set to be sidelined for Houston.

news.body: David Montgomery practiced on Tuesday.
news.head: David Montgomery (groin) practices Tuesday
news.impact: Montgomery is trending towards having a chance to return for Thursday’s game against the Colts.

news.body: David Montgomery is trending in the right direction and "moving a lot better."
news.head: David Montgomery (groin) trending in right direction
news.impact: Montgomery could be in line for a workhorse role on Thursday if he is cleared with Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out. He'll need to continue to be monitored in practice.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed the ball ten times for ten yards and two touchdowns and caught five passes for ten yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Derrick Henry scores twice in loss Monday
news.impact: Henry was incredibly inefficient on Monday night, racking up just 20 yards on 15 total touches. He was able to get two goal-line touchdowns over the course of the game, which left him with a good fantasy total when paired with his five receptions. He should continue to get all of the work in this backfield moving forward, but his efficiency and Baltimore's offensive struggles will call into question his game-to-game consistency.

news.body: Derrick Henry ran 17 times for 57 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Derrick Henry struggles in loss to Jaguars
news.impact: Henry didn't have a touchdown or a reception to save his lackluster rushing totals, as the Jaguars bottled him up all night. The Ravens have now scored no more than 13 points in each of the last four games, and Henry's fantasy points are evidence of that. He at least gets a favorable matchup against the Chargers next time out.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed for 53 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in a 36-10 loss to the Bills. He caught both of his targets for seven yards.
news.head: Derrick Henry finds the end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Henry found the end zone for the first time since Week 4 against the Titans. With Lamar Jackson (thumb) headed to IR and Tyler Huntley's (toe) status uncertain for Week 9, Henry could be in line for a lot of work against the Jaguars in Week 9.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed for 45 yards on 17 carries in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals. He caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards.
news.head: Derrick Henry quiet in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Bengals' defense was able to bottle up Henry all day, leading to his worst performance of the season. The Ravens are hopeful to have Lamar Jackson back in Week 8, which could open up more lanes for Henry against Buffalo.

news.body: Emmett Johnson carried the ball 22 times for 101 yards while also hauling in six of his seven targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Emmett Johnson dominates in Week 10 win over Falcons
news.impact: Johnson took advantage of the absence of RB1 Kenneth Walker III, recording over 140 offensive yards and one or more touchdowns in two of his last three contests. The rookie running back continues to flash game-changing explosiveness out of the backfield for head coach Andy Reid entering a Week 11 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Emmett Johnson will lead Kansas City’s rushing attack Sunday against the Falcons.
news.head: Emmett Johnson to lead Chiefs backfield Sunday
news.impact: Kenneth Walker is being held out due to a groin injury. Johnson has shown flashes this season backing up Walker and now gets his chance to step into the lead role.

news.body: Emmett Johnson rushed once for 15 yards while catching all five of his targets for 128 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Emmett Johnson explodes for 143 yards, touchdown in Week 8
news.impact: Johnson turned a Patrick Mahomes pass into a 73-yard touchdown and finished with 143 total yards on six touches. So, is there a changing of the guard in Kansas City's backfield? No. Kenneth Walker III had 25 touches compared to six for Johnson. That said, 143 yards on six touches should earn Johnson more opportunities moving forward.

news.body: Emmett Johnson caught two of his three targets for 17 yards in a 20-3 loss to Seattle in Week 7.
news.head: Emmett Johnson catches two balls in Week 7
news.impact: Johnson was not given a carry on a sluggish day for the Chiefs on offense. The rookie running back remains an interesting handcuff for fantasy moving forward. He will take on the Broncos in Week 8.

news.body: Jadarian Price ran for 36 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders. He also caught his lone target for eight yards receiving.
news.head: Jadarian Price finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Price was able to score a touchdown for the first time in his career. He continues to look like the 1B in the backfield for Seattle with Zach Charbonnet as the 1A. Price remains a steady flex option.

news.body: Jadarian Price ran for 24 yards on nine carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 54 yards receiving.
news.head: Jadarian Price totals 78 yards from scrimmage Sunday
news.impact: Price led Seattle in receiving on the day, including an impressive 17-yard catch and run. Zach Charbonnet led the Seahawks on the ground on the day. Price should maintain flex value moving forward.

news.body: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 29 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price inefficient in loss Monday
news.impact: Price made his return to the lineup on Monday night after missing several games while on injured reserve. He didn't look great in his first game back, however, rushing at an inefficient clip of 2.9 yards per carry and not being much better in the passing game. He will not be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, especially with Zach Charbonnet also now back in the lineup for the Seahawks.

news.body: The Seahawks are expected to activate RB Jadarian Price from injured reserve for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price (chest) to be activated from IR Monday
news.impact: Price will return after a month-long absence. The Seahawks will have a fully healthy backfield for the first time this season between him and Zach Charbonnet.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of his eight targets for 99 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs scores twice in Munich game
news.impact: Gibbs fell one yard shy of posting a 100-yard game in both rushing and receiving. He continued his dominant season in Germany, bringing his touchdown total up to 13 in nine games. He will be a locked-in top-three fantasy option heading into Week 11 vs. Tampa Bay.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 20 times for 74 yards and one touchdown while failing to catch his lone target in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs reaches end zone in Week 9 win over Dolphins
news.impact: Gibbs has been dynamic out of the backfield of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in five of his last six games. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 23 times for 153 yards and one touchdown while also catching two of his four targets for 15 yards in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs shreds tough Vikings defense in Week 8 win
news.impact: Gibbs has had a nose for the end zone of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in four of his last five contests. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option entering a favorable Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs will play on Sunday against the Vikings.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) will play Sunday
news.impact: Gibbs is good to go despite missing practice to start the week on Wednesday. He will remain in his usual role for the Lions and fantasy managers.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 157 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He did not record a reception on his lone target.
news.head: James Cook III hits pay dirt in Week 10 win
news.impact: Cook found the end zone on a 74-yard rush late the in the fourth quarter to salvage what would have been a disappointing fantasy day. Cook has found the end zone in every game this season since Week 2 against Detroit. Cook will look to continue his strong season against Miami in Week 11.

news.body: James Cook II rushed for 107 yards and a touchdown on 31 carries in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: James Cook II goes over 100 yards, finds end zone in Week 9
news.impact: This was a true workhorse effort from Cook. The last time he got 30-plus carries was Week 13 of last season. Cook is one of only three backs in the league currently averaging over 100 rushing yards per game, and Jahmyr Gibbs is the only player carrying the ball more times per game than Cook.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 80 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He caught 2-of-3 targets for 21 yards.
news.head: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Cook found the end zone on a five-yard carry in the third quarter. Cook has a rushing touchdown in six straight games. Cook and the Bills have a tough matchup in Week 9 against a strong Vikings' defense.

news.body: James Cook III rushed the ball 22 times for 95 yards and a touchdown and caught three passes for 58 yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: James Cook III plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Cook played great on Sunday. He finished with over 150 total yards and a touchdown against the Raiders, which helped to lead the Bills to a big win on the road. He should continue to be a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 16 times for 63 yards while also catching his lone target for four yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.head: Javonte Williams leads backfield in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Williams has been productive out of the backfield of late, rushing for over 60 yards in three of his last four contests. The running back will look to take advantage of an underperforming Tennessee Titans defense in Week 11.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 20 times for 101 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 23 yards on five targets in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 9
news.impact: Williams notched his second 100-yard rushing game of the season in the close win over Indy. The veteran running back has been a very reliable fantasy option this season, posting 10 all-purpose touchdowns through nine games. An every-week RB1 in fantasy, Williams will take on the 49ers in Week 10.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 24 times for 56 yards while also catching one of his two targets for one yard in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Javonte Williams bottled up in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Williams was held in check out of the backfield, failing to reach the end zone for the first time in his last six contests. The running back will look to get back on track against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: Javonte Williams rushed the ball 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Javonte Williams sets career high in yards Monday
news.impact: Williams was absolutely dominant on Monday night. He set a new career high with 155 rushing yards over the course of the game, and he was also able to get into the end zone towards the end of the game, which was the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should be well pleased with his performance in this primetime matchup.

news.body: Jaylen Warren rushed the ball seven times for 15 yards and caught five passes for 26 yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Jaylen Warren underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Warren wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He finished with just 15 yards on the ground, but his involvement in the passing game was able to pad his fantasy total in PPR scoring formats. He should bounce back and return to being a high-end fantasy option sometime in the very near future.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Jaylen Warren runs for 143 yards Sunday
news.impact: Warren did not catch either of his two targets. He tied his career-high in rushing despite Rico Dowdle seeing 15 carries himself. Warren remains a borderline RB1/RB2 heading into the Steelers bye week.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran 18 times for 101 yards and caught three of four targets for 36 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Warren goes off against Saints
news.impact: Warren was the clear lead back for the Steelers on Sunday, showing markedly better efficiency than fellow RB Rico Dowdle. A two-back system will still likely be employed to keep Warren fresh, but Warren is looking like a solid weekly RB1 candidate.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 50 yards on 14 carries in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 28 yards receiving.
news.head: Jaylen Warren sees 16 touches Sunday
news.impact: Warren was the lead back in the Steelers backfield in the fourth quarter and overtime period over Rico Dowdle. He'll remain an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: The Cardinals placed RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) placed on IR
news.impact: Love suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's win over the Cowboys. He is expected to be sidelined for the next 4-5 weeks. Pending the status of Bam Knight, Tyler Allgeier will figure to return to the lead role in the Cardinals backfield.

news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters RB Jeremiyah Love has a new ankle injury.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love has new ankle injury
news.impact: Love will be further evaluated throughout the week.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is questionable to return for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Love suffered the apparent ankle injury in the second quarter, rushing nine times for 23 yards prior to exiting. Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier will see increased touches out of the Arizona backfield in Love’s absence.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will play for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will play Sunday

news.body: J.K. Dobbins finished with one reception for four yards as the Broncos defeated the Panthers 26-21 in Week 9.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins struggles again in Week 9
news.impact: Dobbins has lost considerable ground to Jonah Coleman over the last three games. The latter had 21 touches for 88 yards and a touchdown Sunday. Dobbins, meanwhile, hasn't scored since Week 7. The Broncos have shifted their backfield toward Coleman, leaving Dobbins difficult to trust as a fantasy starter.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed seven times for 13 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins held to 13 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't targeted and averaged 1.9 yards per carry. Meanwhile, Jonah Coleman had 15 touches for 104 total yards and scored the game-winning touchdown. Dobbins had scored in three straight games entering Sunday, but Coleman has led Denver's running backs in carries in both games since returning. The former is becoming touchdown-dependent.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed six times for 23 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins Finds End Zone in Week 7
news.impact: Dobbins scored from one yard out late in the third quarter, giving him a touchdown for the third consecutive game. The problem was everything else. His six carries were fewer than both Jonah Coleman's nine and Bo Nix's seven, while RJ Harvey remained involved in the passing game. Dobbins continues to find the end zone, but his workload took a significant hit with Coleman back. The former enters flex territory.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins ran 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown in Denver's 17-14 win over Seattle on Thursday. He also caught three passes for five yards.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins punches in touchdown in win
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't overly efficient in this game, with his long run of 16 yards meaning his other 16 carries went for 25 yards. Still, a touchdown and a few receptions can cover a multitude of sins. He's a volume-based RB3 moving forward.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 17 times for 57 yards and one touchdown while catching four passes for 31 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Jonah Coleman scores touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Coleman scored from nine yards out in the fourth quarter to give Denver a 19-14 lead. More importantly, he has now led the Broncos in rushing in three straight games since returning from injured reserve. Coleman also caught four passes for the second consecutive week. So, what happened to J.K. Dobbins' role? Coleman has taken over a significant portion of the backfield, including scoring opportunities. The rookie has established himself as Denver's most productive fantasy running back.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 11 times for 41 yards and one touchdown, while catching four of five targets for 63 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Jonah Coleman totals 104 yards, scores in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman led the Broncos' running backs in carries for the second straight game. More importantly, he out-touched J.K. Dobbins 15-7 and scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. Coleman also had a 51-yard reception on the final touchdown drive. So, what does the Broncos' backfield look like after two games with Coleman back? He has 24 carries compared to 13 for Dobbins. Coleman has entered the weekly starter fantasy conversation.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed nine times for 54 yards, while catching both of his targets for 15 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Jonah Coleman Totals 69 Yards in Return
news.impact: Coleman returned from injured reserve and immediately led Denver's running backs with nine carries, averaging six yards per attempt. J.K. Dobbins still received the goal-line touchdown, and RJ Harvey scored through the air, but Coleman's usage in his first game back is difficult to ignore. He's worth rostering as Denver sorts out what could become a three-man backfield. Coleman is worth a start next week for Zero RB drafters.

news.body: Jonah Coleman (ankle) is active for Week 7 for the Denver Broncos against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jonah Coleman (ankle) active for Week 7
news.impact: Coleman will suit up after being activated earlier in the week from injured reserve, providing head coach Sean Payton with another option as part of a backfield including RJ Harvey and J.K. Dobbins against the Cardinals Sunday.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor gained 21 yards on 11 carries and just six yards on four receptions in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor does very little with 15 touches Thursday night
news.impact: Taylor had pretty much his worst game of the season Thursday night, as the Colts were dominated in all facets by the Texans. The star running back is stuck in an impotent offense with a team that is now 3-8 and looking to the future. Better games should still lay ahead, but the Colts may also decide to ease off Taylor's usage down the stretch.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor ran 16 times for 83 yards and caught two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor goes for 103 yards in win over Miami
news.impact: Taylor led the offense in touches but it was Seth McGowan scoring the touchdown on Sunday. Taylor should still have decent volume most weeks, but his upside is going to be limited as long as the Colts QB play is this poor.

news.body: The Colts won’t trade RB Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's deadline.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor will not be traded by Colts
news.impact: Pelissero notes that multiple teams offered a second-round pick and more for Taylor, but the Colts wanted more in a deal for him. He'll remain in Indianapolis.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor carried the ball 13 times for 46 yards while catching all five of his targets for 18 yards and losing a fumble in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor loses fumble in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Taylor struggled in what might have been his final game in a Colts uniform with trade rumors swirling around him. The veteran running back has rushed for 656 yards and eight touchdowns through nine games this year. If the Colts don't trade him by Tuesday's trade deadline, he will face the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Jordan Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards while failing to catch his only target in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.head: Jordan Mason leads backfield in Week 10 win over Packers
news.impact: Mason has struggled to find room out of the Minnesota backfield to this point, totaling less than 60 offensive yards in four of his five games. The running back remains part of an underperforming Minnesota backfield alongside Aaron Jones Sr. entering a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Jordan Mason rushed for 35 yards on six carries and added just seven yards on two receptions in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Jordan Mason totals 42 yards on Monday night
news.impact: Mason missed a large chunk of the season early on. Then, he returned to gain 68 yards on 15 carries in a win over the Colts in Week 7. Any encouragement that resulted from that performance is gone now, as the Vikings just cannot get things together on offense. Mason has gained 55 yards on just 14 carries combined over the last two games. He's a bench stash for fantasy purposes right now.

news.body: Jordan Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Jordan Mason bottled up in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Mason struggled to find running room in a losing effort, finishing with under 50 rushing yards for the first time in three contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jordan Mason ran for 68 yards on 15 carries in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jordan Mason leads Vikings backfield in return Sunday
news.impact: Mason did not start the game, but he was on the field more and saw more opportunity than Aaron Jones. He'll be an RB2 play next week against the Lions.

news.body: Josh Jacobs underwent successful surgery on Friday.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) undergoes successful surgery
news.impact: Jacobs had surgery on his fractured right ring finger. He is hopeful to return in 2-to-3 weeks.

news.body: Josh Jacobs (finger) has officially been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) officially ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Jacobs has officially been ruled out after undergoing a procedure to address a finger injury he suffered last week. There's a real chance that he will miss more time beyond this game, so fantasy managers should expect more work for Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs will have finger surgery on Friday.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) to undergo surgery Friday
news.impact: Once Jacobs undergoes the surgery, Jacobs will have a more clear timetable for his return.

news.body: Packers RB Josh Jacobs could return in 2-to-3 weeks.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (finger) could return in 2-to-3 weeks
news.impact: Jacobs will have surgery later this week on his broken ring finger. The Packers will decide on Saturday if an IR stint is necessary.

news.body: Justice Hill rushed the ball three times for four yards and hauled in 5-of-7 targets for 34 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Justice Hill active as receiver in win Monday
news.impact: Hill was a non-factor in the rushing game on Monday night, but he was able to get involved as a pass catcher, finishing with five catches for 34 yards. Those are high-value touches, but fantasy managers still shouldn't expect him to be a reliable fantasy asset for the foreseeable future given his lack of consistent work in the rushing game.

news.body: Justice Hill ran nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday. He also caught three passes for seven yards.
news.head: Justice Hill breaks away for long TD in loss
news.impact: Hill managed the one explosive play by the Ravens all night, breaking away for a long touchdown late in the game. He could be an interesting flex option moving forward as the Ravens change of pace back.

news.body: Justice Hill (groin) is set to play in Thursday night's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Justice Hill (groin) set to play Thursday
news.impact: Hill is managing a minor ankle issue right now, but he carries no injury designation for Thursday and should be a full go against the Jaguars. Fantasy managers can't really trust him on a week-to-week basis at this point in the season, however.

news.body: Justice Hill was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Justice Hill (groin) logs full practice Tuesday
news.impact: Hill will remain in his change-of-pace role behind Derrick Henry for Thursday’s game against the Jaguars.

news.body: Kaelon Black rushed 11 times for 53 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for 13 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys in Week 10.
news.head: Kaelon Black reaches end zone in Week 10 win
news.impact: Black has been impactful out of the San Francisco backfield of late, recording over 60 offensive yards in each of his last three contests. The running back remains an explosive complement to RB1 Christian McCaffrey ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Kaelon Black ran for 70 yards on 11 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Kaelon Black runs for 70 yards Sunday
news.impact: Black led San Francisco in rushing despite seeing seven fewer carries than Christian McCaffrey. He did not see a target in the passing game. He remains a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.

news.body: Kaelon Black rushed for 63 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Kaelon Black finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Black led the 49ers in carries Sunday afternoon and gashed the Falcons' defense for a 30-yard TD run in the second quarter. Christian McCaffrey did deal with a thigh issue in this one and ended up only outtouching Black 13-to-12. This was a nice game for Black, but he remains useful to fantasy managers only as a handcuff to McCaffrey.

news.body: Kaelon Black carried the ball eight times for 34 yards while catching his lone target for a three-yard gain in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6's Monday night game.
news.head: Kaelon Black sees nine touches in MNF win
news.impact: Black looked good playing behind Christian McCaffrey, averaging 4.3 yards per carry for the 49ers. The rookie remains one of the top handcuffs in fantasy heading into a Week 7 matchup vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: The Chiefs are letting Walker sit out for a second-straight game as he continues to nurse a groin injury that he recently suffered. It's not considered a serious issue at this point, however, so he seems to have a chance to play in Week 12's matchup against the Bills next Thursday night. Emmett Johnson was dominant as the Chiefs' RB1 last week and will be a must-start fantasy option in a favorable matchup against the Cardinals this week.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Walker is continuing to trend towards missing a second straight game. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: It was reported to begin the week that Walker could sit another game on Sunday. It continues to trend in that direction with Walker missing practice to begin the week.

news.body: Ian Rapoport said he “wouldn’t be surprised” if Kenneth Walker sat in Week 11 to make sure that his groin is fully healed.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III (groin) could sit Week 11
news.impact: The Chiefs enter this week as huge favorites against the Cardinals. Emmett Johnson could get another week to be in the workhorse role in the Chiefs backfield.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell carried the ball five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell posts 60 receiving yards in Week 9
news.impact: Gainwell finished second on the team in receiving, doing most of his damage on a 44-yard reception. The veteran tailback has carved out a solid role behind Bucky Irving in Tampa, running for 305 yards while adding 15 catches for 121 yards and a touchdown in nine games. He will be on bye in Week 10.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran for 140 yards on 25 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell sees 25 carries Sunday
news.impact: Gainwell and Bucky Irving combined for 310 rushing yards on 52 carries on a day where Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. He'll be an RB3/RB4 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell (hip) is officially active for Week 8 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Brianna Dix.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) active for Week 8
news.impact: Gainwell will suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation, boosting a Tampa Bay backfield that will utilize both Gainwell and Bucky Irving against the Falcons Sunday.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: The Buccaneers did not have any elevations from their practice squad. Gainwell remains listed as questionable, but he will likely be available for Sunday.

news.body: Kyle Monangai is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Saints.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (toe) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Monangai is officially good to go after getting in full practices all week. He'll return to being an RB2/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (toe) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (toe) practices in full Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Monangai was a full participant for a second-straight practice on Thursday, which means that he will almost certainly play in Week 11. His anticipated return will mean less work for D'Andre Swift and especially Roschon Johnson moving forward.

news.body: Kyle Monangai (toe) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (toe) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Monangai is fully on track to make his return to the lineup in Week 11. He was estimated to be a full participant on the team's first injury report of the week, so unless something happens between now and Sunday, fantasy managers should expect him to suit up and play against the Saints. His return will mean less work for D'Andre Swift and Roschon Johnson moving forward.

news.body: Kyle Monangai practiced again on Tuesday.
news.head: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) practices Tuesday
news.impact: Monangai continues to trend towards returning on Sunday against the Bucs.

news.body: Kyren Williams ran for 23 yards on 12 carries in the Rams 34-6 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 2-of-5 targets for nine yards receiving.
news.head: Kyren Williams quiet Sunday
news.impact: Williams started the game for the Rams per usual, but Blake Corum wound up being the hot hand on the day. He did have a receiving touchdown called back. Despite a down performance this week, Williams remains a steady RB2.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed 15 times for 45 yards and caught three passes for 16 yards in Sunday’s win over the Commanders.
news.head: Kyren Williams totals 61 scoreless yards in win
news.impact: Kyren out-touched fellow running back Blake Corum 18 to 11 in the contest, but only recorded 3 more all-purpose yards. Despite the down game, Williams remains a locked-and-loaded RB1 for Week 10's matchup against the Cardinals.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball 16 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Kyren Williams finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Williams contributed well on Sunday. He was able to churn out 56 yards and a touchdown on the ground, but he wasn't able to contribute much in the passing game, which hurt his fantasy total. He should continue to be a good fantasy asset moving forward, though the increasing involvement of Blake Corum isn't what fantasy managers want to see.

news.body: Kyren Williams carried the ball 16 times for 99 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in both of his targets for 22 yards in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Kyren Williams leads backfield in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in three of his last four contests. The running back remains one of the more explosive offensive options as part of an injury-ravaged Rams offense for head coach Sean McVay, with a Week 8 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II ran 20 times for 76 yards and also caught four of five targets for 39 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II goes for 76 yards on the ground in loss
news.impact: Gordon wasn't very efficient on the ground, but had some receiving work to keep him in RB2 territory. It's gonna be tough next week against Buffalo, but he's a low-end, volume-based RB2.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II carried the ball 16 times for 55 yards while also hauling in his lone target for nine yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II leads backfield in Week 9 loss to Lions
news.impact: Gordon II has capitalized on increased touches out of the Miami backfield of late, logging over 60 offensive yards in each of his last five contests. The running back remains one of the few stable options as part of an underwhelming Miami offense to this point ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II ran 19 times for 69 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He also failed to catch his only target.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II runs for 69 yards in loss
news.impact: After four straight weeks with a rushing touchdown and three straight weeks of 88+ rushing yards, Gordon finally had himself a down game. That's to be expected for a player who has almost zero passing game involvement; the floor falls out when receiving is nil. He will face off against the Lions next weekend.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed for 103 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He caught 1-of-3 targets for no yards.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: Gordon has scored in four straight games and tallied 80+ rushing yards in three straight contests. Jaylen Wright exited the game with a quad injury, which could to Gordon seeing plenty of work again in Week 8 if Wright is unable to play against New England.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball 22 times for 105 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Omarion Hampton plays well in win Monday
news.impact: The Chargers finally gave Hampton the bulk of the work in their backfield on Monday night, and he was able to put up over 100 yards and a touchdown on good efficiency en route to the team's first win. It seems reasonable to assume that they will continue to give him the majority of touches after he found success in this game, so fantasy managers should be looking to pick him up if he was dropped earlier in the season in their league.

news.body: Omarion Hampton carried the ball 13 times for 60 yards in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Houston Texans.
news.head: Omarion Hampton leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Hampton led the backfield in carries on Sunday and was able to rush for a team-high 60 yards. His efficiency wasn't bad, but he didn't get in the end zone and didn't catch any passes, so his fantasy total remained poor. It's encouraging to see the team finally consolidating some work for him, but he is unlikely to be relevant anytime soon with how pitiful their offense continues to look.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball nine times for 20 yards and caught two passes for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Omarion Hampton disappoints again in loss Sunday
news.impact: Hampton hasn't been able to get anything going over the course of the season, and Sunday was no exception. He totaled just 27 yards on his 11 touches and wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He should not be started in nearly any league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed seven times for 18 yards while catching all four of his targets for 21 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Omarion Hampton Totals 39 Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Hampton averaged just 2.6 yards per carry, but the bigger concern is the workload. Kimani Vidal also received seven carries and finished with seven touches compared to Hampton's 11. The four receptions helped Hampton in PPR formats, but a split backfield on an 0-6 offense isn't an ideal fantasy situation.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins rushed for 38 yards and a touchdown on 10 carries, adding three receptions for 33 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins gains 71 yards, finds the end zone in Week 10
news.impact: Judkins totaled over 70 yards of offense on his 13 touches in Sunday's comeback win over the Texans. The second-year back put the Browns ahead with a five-yard TD plunge with less than a minute left to go in the game. Judkins is up to 423 yards and four touchdowns on the ground through nine games. He's also caught at least three passes four times this season.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran 15 times for 43 yards in the Browns' 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints on Sunday. He also caught his only target for two yards.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins struggles to get going against Saints defense
news.impact: This was a prime spot for Judkins to go off, and he didn't. The Saints had been one of the best matchups for running backs this season, and Judkins failed to deliver. He's only been above 10 PPR points twice this season and is a low-end RB3 option at best until he shows signs of life.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran for 25 yards on 11 carries in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 24 yards receiving.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins shut down on ground Sunday
news.impact: Judkins was completely stifled on the ground all afternoon. He will look to bounce back as an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins carried the ball 17 times for 96 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for an eight-yard gain in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins scores twice in Week 7 win
news.impact: Judkins turned in one of his better games as a pro, finding the end zone on runs of five and six yards in the win. He looked good after missing the previous week with an ankle injury. Judkins now has three rushing touchdowns across six contests this season. He will be on the RB2 radar in Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Rachaad White was limited in practice on Friday.
news.head: Rachaad White (heel) limited in practice Friday
news.impact: White was added to the injury report. He was still able to practice in limited fashion.

news.body: Rachaad White carried the ball 11 times for 47 yards and caught one of his two targets for a five-yard gain in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Rachaad White runs for 47 yards in Week 10 win
news.impact: White averaged a solid 4.3 yards per carry but was unable to do much damage in the passing game. Meanwhile, Austin Ekeler cut into his workload more than usual as he logged his highest touch total of the season, with 13. With 409 all-purpose yards and three TDs this season, White will be a flex option in fantasy in Week 11 against the Bengals.

news.body: Rachaad White rushed seven times for 28 yards and caught two passes for 41 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Rachaad White rushes for 28 yards, adds 41 through the air in loss
news.impact: White had a near 50-50 split with Austin Ekeler, but outproduced him by 35 yards. Next up, the Commanders will face the Giants on Thursday Night Football, where White will end up in the RB3/flex range.

news.body: Rachaad White carried the ball 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of his three targets for five yards in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Rachaad White finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: White found the end zone for the second straight game as he punched in a one-yard score to put the game out of reach with 1:52 left in regulation. White has been a solid fantasy running back while leading the Washington backfield with Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve and should continue to be in fantasy lineups in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson carried the ball six times for four yards and caught his lone target for a one-yard gain in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson held to four rushing yards in Week 10
news.impact: Stevenson dealt with a knee injury all week and likely saw his role in the rushing attack scaled back a bit, especially with the Patriots losing 21-3 at halftime. Stevenson will have a chance to heal up during his Week 11 bye before he takes on the Chargers in Week 12.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is officially active for Week 10 for the New England Patriots against the Detroit Lions according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) active for Week 10
news.impact: Stevenson will take the field after clearing through pregame tests on his knee, boosting a New England backfield missing TreVeyon Henderson (illness) and should receive the majority of backfield touches against the Lions Sunday.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Lions.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Stevenson was expected to miss some time, but he was able to log back-to-back limited practices to end the week. He'll have a chance to play on Sunday.

news.body: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returns to limited practice Thursday
news.impact: Stevenson was able to make his return to practice on Thursday and was a limited participant. Early reports indicated that he was set to miss multiple weeks with this injury, but he seems to be recovering much quicker than expected and may miss little, if any, time.
