This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as he will likely see the bulk of the work in New England's backfield if he's cleared to play in time for Sunday's game.

news.body: Rico Dowdle rushed the ball five times for 26 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Rico Dowdle quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Dowdle wasn't effective on Sunday, finishing with just 34 scoreless yards on seven total touches. He will continue to see involvement in this offense moving forward but shouldn't be regarded as much more than a handcuff fantasy asset behind Jaylen Warren for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Rico Dowdle finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Dowdle saw a fairly decent role behind Jaylen Warren in Sunday's win. He'll be on the RB3 radar moving forward if his current role holds.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran 9 times for 41 yards and caught all six of his targets for 45 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Rico Dowdle snags six passes in win
news.impact: Dowdle really saw his numbers come up in this game after a disappointing outing against Tampa Bay. Not that his efficiency running the ball was bad then, but he simply didn't receive many opportunities. Dowdle is looking like an RB3 type of play moving forward.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) is officially active for Week 7 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the New Orleans Saints according to Nick Farabaugh.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) active for Week 7
news.impact: Dowdle will suit up after struggling through limited practice sessions late in the week, offering head coach Mike McCarthy another option out of the Pittsburgh backfield behind Jaylen Warren against the Saints.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed the ball six times for 14 yards and a touchdown while adding four catches for 25 yards through the air in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Samaje Perine finds end zone in win Sunday
news.impact: Perine had himself a nice game on Sunday. He wasn't very productive on the ground, but he was able to make up for that by getting into the end zone once and getting involved in the receiving game. He will continue to see meaningful touches for this offense moving forward, though he won't be a good fantasy option as long as he's behind Chase Brown in the pecking order.

news.body: Samaje Perine carried the ball four times for 10 yards and caught his lone target for a nine-yard gain in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Samaje Perine sees five touches in Week 8
news.impact: Perine was quiet in the high-scoring win while Chase Brown racked up 20 touches. The veteran tailback saw 14 carries for the Bengals two games ago but he has taken a backseat to Brown ever since. Perine will not be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed for 16 yards and a touchdown on four carries in a 35-13 2in over the Ravens.
news.head: Samaje Perine finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: Perine plunged into the end zone on a one-yard rush early in the fourth quarter to extend the Bengals' lead. The veteran continues to see limited work and can remain off fantasy managers' radar for now.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed the ball 14 times for 68 yards and caught two passes for ten yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Samaje Perine leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Perine had a good game on Sunday. He was Cincinnati's leading rusher against the Dolphins and actually saw more overall carries than Chase Brown, who usually acts as the team's RB1. The veteran could be relevant moving forward if he can continue to accumulate significant touches on this offense moving forward.

news.body: Saquon Barkley rushed the ball 13 times for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Saquon Barkley finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Barkley was able to get into the end zone once on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do anything outside of that. He finished with just 22 yards over the course of the game and didn't catch a single pass, which really hurt his fantasy total. He will be an unreliable starter for as long as Joe Milton III remains the starting quarterback for Philadelphia moving forward.

news.body: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Barkley is still dealing with the nagging effects of a hamstring and back issue, but he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will play against the Giants. The team may still limit his workload, but he will continue to have explosive week-to-week upside every time he's on the field, even if that upside seems harder to attain now with Joe Milton III set to start at quarterback for the Eagles.

news.body: Saquon Barkley is practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Saquon Barkley practicing Thursday
news.impact: Barkley is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against his former team in the Giants. He'll remain on the RB2 radar for fantasy managers.

news.body: Saquon Barkley told reporters he was told by the Eagles that he would not be traded.
news.head: Saquon Barkley says he will not be traded
news.impact: Despite the Eagles falling to 2-6 on the season, it appears Barkley will not be going anywhere. There had been trade rumors of him potentially being moved before this year's deadline.

news.body: Tony Pollard is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Tony Pollard off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Pollard got a rest day from practice on Thursday. He will remain an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Tony Pollard (rest) didn't take part in Tennessee's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tony Pollard (rest) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: Pollard was given the day off on Thursday as a veteran rest day. He should be back at practice on Friday and is expected to be a full go for Week 11.

news.body: Tony Pollard ran 9 times for 33 yards and caught 8 of 9 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Tony Pollard explodes for 66 receiving yards in loss
news.impact: Pollard ended Sunday's game one yard shy of 100 yards on the day. His 66 receiving yards were the second-most on the team, and his eight catches led the team. Tyjae Spears had more efficiency on his four rushing attempts, but played clear second fiddle to Pollard. Keep Pollard in lineups as a volume RB3 with RB2 upside, especially if the Titans keep up their newfound energy.

news.body: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Pollard will be fully good to go for Week 10, despite missing Thursday's practice with a minor finger issue and as a rest day. He will see almost all of the work in Tennessee's backfield if Tyjae Spears (knee) is ruled out ahead of game time.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. rushed for 14 yards on eight carries in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. quiet in Week 10
news.impact: Etienne returned to action for the first time since suffering a hamstring injury in Week 3. His return was expected to be a boost for the Saints' running game, but the Panthers' defense was able to keep it in check. Etienne and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11.

news.body: Saints RB Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Panthers.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) officially active for Week 10
news.impact: Etienne was activated from injured reserve and is expected to lead the Saints' backfield. Alvin Kamara will likely see the bulk of his playing time on passing downs against the Panthers.

news.body: The Saints plan to activate RB Travis Etienne Jr. from injured reserve on Saturday.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to be activated from IR
news.impact: Etienne is in line to make his return for Sunday's game against the Panthers. He should return to his lead role in the Saints backfield.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Panthers.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Etienne was limited in practice to start the week before ending the week with a full practice. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

news.body: The Patriots placed RB TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) placed on IR
news.impact: Henderson had already been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions. He will miss at least four more games. Rhamondre Stevenson and Corey Kiner will lead the Patriots backfield.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out for Week 10 against the Lions.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 10
news.impact: Henderson will remain sidelined due to an illness. He holds no clear timetable to return.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday’s contest between the New England Patriots and Green Bay Packers according to Evan Lazar.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 9
news.impact: Henderson will not suit while continuing to battle ongoing illness issues for head coach Mike Vrabel, with Rhamondre Stevenson once again expected to receive a sizeable workload out of the New England backfield against the Packers Sunday.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Henderson is continuing to trend towards missing another game for the Patriots. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: Tyjae Spears is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Spears finished the week with a full practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Spears was back at practice on Thursday. He missed Wednesday's practice due to a knee issue, but it's not a serious issue at this point and he is expected to play through it on Sunday. He will continue to have a limited role behind Tony Pollard on the team's depth chart, however.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (knee) did not take part in Tennessee's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: The Titans have made a habit of limiting Spears' workload at practice this season, so it comes as no surprise that he was a non-participant to start the week on Wednesday. It looks likely that he will play in Week 11, however, assuming he doesn't suffer a setback between now and then.

news.body: Tyjae Spears ran four times for 28 yards and caught his only target for no gain in the Titans' 40-23 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears gets five touches in loss to Jags
news.impact: Spears played second fiddle to Tony Pollard in this game, as has become a theme over the last few weeks. Spears has moments of efficiency, like he did when rushing today, but he can't seem to sustain any workload, likely due to his lengthy injury history. He's a handcuff at best with Pollard healthy.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran for 14 yards on five carries in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier quiet Sunday
news.impact: The Cardinals backfield returned to a committee with Bam Knight healthy. They'll both be tougher to trust in lineups splitting snaps on what is currently a bad offense.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier ran for 46 yards on 17 carries in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for zero yards receiving.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier sees 17 carries Sunday
news.impact: With Jeremiyah Love on IR and Bam Knight in concussion protocol, Allgeier took over the workhorse role in the Cardinals backfield. He was the only running back to see a carry for Arizona. From a volume standpoint, he'll be an RB2 play next week against the Rams if Knight remains sidelined.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier carried the ball 11 times for 147 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all five of his targets for 44 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier dynamic in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Allgeier took advantage of an Arizona backfield attack that lost Jeremiyah Love and Bam Knight, rushing for over 50 yards for the first time in his last seven contests. The running back could be in line for a sizeable workload if both Love and Knight remain sidelined for a Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier (toe) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Allgeier will return to his depth role with Jeremiyah Love slated to return.

news.body: Woody Marks has been ruled out for Thursday’s game against the Colts.
news.head: Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out for Week 11
news.impact: Marks left this past week's game with a concussion. He will be sidelined on a short week for the Texans.

news.body: Woody Marks exited Sunday's game early with a concussion and did not return.
news.head: Woody Marks gains 65 yards, leaves with concussion Sunday
news.impact: Marks gained 50 yards on 12 carries and caught one pass for 15 yards before leaving what ended up being a 27-24 loss to the Browns. With a quick turnaround coming for a matchup against the Colts on Thursday, Marks' chances to play in Week 11 seem very slim. Emari Demercado could see plenty of work if Marks sits.

news.body: Woody Marks (knee) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Woody Marks (knee) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Marks is set to be a full go on Sunday, despite managing a knee injury at practice throughout the week. He will only see enough work to be fantasy relevant if David Montgomery (groin) is ruled out ahead of game time, however.

news.body: Woody Marks returned to practice on Friday.
news.head: Woody Marks (knee) back at practice Friday
news.impact: Marks was absent from practice on Thursday. He should be on track to be ready to go for Sunday.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet ran for 94 yards on 20 carries in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet runs for 94 yards Sunday
news.impact: Despite it just being a few games for Charbonnet since returning from his torn ACL, he continues to impress on the ground. He remains a solid RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet ran for 77 yards on 16 carries in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals. He also caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards receiving.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet runs for 77 yards Sunday
news.impact: Charbonnet looked much better in his second game back from injury. He has also had another impressive run called back due to a penalty. He should remain on the flex radar moving forward.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet rushed the ball six times for 23 yards and caught three passes for six yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet quiet in return game Monday
news.impact: Charbonnet made his season debut for the Seahawks on Monday night after missing an extended period of time recovering from a significant knee injury. He didn't make headlines in his first game back, however, racking up just 29 total yards on his nine touches over the course of the night. He will likely continue to get more involved as he continues to ramp back up to a full workload over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) off injury report Monday
news.impact: Charbonnet will be ready to make his season debut. He'll be a touchdown dependent flex play in his first game back for fantasy managers.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught two of three targets for nine yards and a score in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Brenton Strange snags touchdown in win
news.impact: Strange's fantasy day was saved by the touchdown. He went through a nice four-week stretch earlier this season, but in his last two weeks, he has just 31 yards and a score. It's a rough patch for the Jags TE1, but with the offense humming as it is, his weeks will come once again.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 22 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Brenton Strange goes for 22 yards in win
news.impact: It was a bit of a letdown after Strange had been successful in the last few weeks as a streaming tight end play. Nate Boerkircher has started to get more involved in recent weeks, and that could be limiting Strange's upside.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Brenton Strange goes for 55 receiving yards on Sunday
news.impact: Strange had the longest gain of his career Sunday, as he went 46 yards on QB Trevor Lawrence's first pass of the game. Lawrence only completed 10 passes in this contest, so Strange and the rest of the Jaguars route runners didn't deliver huge production for fantasy managers. In fact, Strange was one of three Jaguars to tie for the team lead in receptions. He also tied running back Bhayshul Tuten for the team lead in receiving yards. Strange is having a solid season, but the Jaguars run a largely balanced attack, with Lawrence spreading the ball around to a variety of targets.

news.body: Brenton Strange (eye) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Brenton Strange (eye) cleared to play Sunday
news.impact: Strange has been listed on the injury report throughout the week due to a minor eye issue, but it won't stop him from playing in a full capacity in Week 8. He may see more work than usual if Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is ruled out against the Colts.

news.body: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Bowers is dealing with a pair of injuries right now and is going to be questionable to play on Sunday as a result, according to HC Klint Kubiak. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health heading into the weekend, as he will remain a must-start fantasy option if active, even if he's not playing at less than full strength.

news.body: Brock Bowers was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Bowers returned to a limited practice. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: Brock Bowers is at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle) at practice Thursday
news.impact: Bowers is going to attempt to practice as he manages an ankle injury. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report.

news.body: Brock Bowers (ankle) is not taking part in Las Vegas' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Bowers suffered an ankle injury in last week's loss to the Seahawks and is not practicing on Wednesday as a result. It seems more likely than not that he will be sidelined in Week 11, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week. Fantasy managers should prepare as if he'll be out but continue to keep tabs on him for the rest of the week.

news.body: Cade Otton caught four of his eight targets for 25 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Cade Otton draws eight targets in Week 9
news.impact: Otton led the Bucs in targets, although he failed to do much with the opportunities. The veteran tight end has now caught 23 passes for 211 scoreless yards through nine games. A low-end TE2 for fantasy purposes, Otton will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Cade Otton was not targeted in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Cade Otton does not see target Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield attempted only three passes on Sunday and he did not complete any of them. Otton will be a TE2 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Cade Otton failed to haul in his only target in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Cade Otton silent in Sunday win
news.impact: Otton was running wind sprints once again, and now has just three targets and four receiving yards to his name over the last two weekends of football. He's best left on waivers right now, as his value has primarily been when the Bucs are without any notable receivers.

news.body: Cade Otton caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Cade Otton quiet Sunday
news.impact: Otton remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his eight targets for 24 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo catches four passes in TNF win
news.impact: Okonkwo finished second on the team in targets despite missing some time during the game with a back issue. He was able to return to the game after getting the injury checked out, but fellow tight end Ben Sinnott caught a touchdown pass during his absence. Okonkwo now has 27 catches for 263 yards through seven contests. He will look for his first TD of the season in Week 11 vs. the Cincinnati Bengals.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo had seven receptions for 57 yards in Sunday's loss to the Rams.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo goes 7/57 in loss
news.impact: Chig led his team in receptions and put together a respectable performance for the struggling Commanders. Okonkwo will be in the high-end TE2 range for TNF against the Giants.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught two of his four targets for 32 yards and lost a fumble in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo catches two balls in Week 8
news.impact: Okonkwo was quiet despite the Commanders playing their first game without Terry McLaurin. The veteran tight end will look to bounce back in Week 9 vs. the Rams. He can be treated as a TE2 in fantasy for that matchup.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught all seven of his targets for 69 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo goes for seven catches, 69 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Okonkwo led the Commanders in receiving in the close loss on Monday night. The veteran tight end has caught at least four passes while reaching at least 60 yards in two straight games. He could be in store for a larger role after his bye in Week 7, as Terry McLaurin was carted off the field on Monday vs. the 49ers with a knee injury.

news.body: Colston Loveland caught four of his six targets for 54 yards in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Colston Loveland catches four passes in Week 9
news.impact: Loveland was quiet for most of the evening, catching two passes for 44 yards on the team's final drive of the game. The second-year tight end has caught 37 passes for 363 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this year. A low-end TE1 in fantasy, Loveland will be on bye in Week 10.

news.body: Colston Loveland hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 65 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Colston Loveland catches seven passes Monday
news.impact: Loveland saw good involvement on Monday night. He was tied for the most targets and receptions out of anyone on the team, and he was able to turn his seven catches into 65 yards against the Seahawks. Fantasy managers should feel good about his chances at a breakout over the back half of the season.

news.body: Bears TE Colston Loveland was removed from the injury report for Monday's game against the Seahawks.
news.head: Colston Loveland (neck) removed from injury report for Week 8
news.impact: Loveland was added to the injury report on Friday. He will be good to go in a tough matchup against Seattle.

news.body: Colston Loveland was limited in practice on Friday.
news.head: Colston Loveland (neck) limited in practice Friday
news.impact: Loveland was a late addition to the injury report. He will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday heading into Monday's game against the Seahawks.

news.body: Dallas Goedert caught 5-of-6 targets for 50 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Dallas Goedert solid in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran finished with a solid 50 yards on five catches, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a fantasy total that was just okay. He isn't a great fantasy option at this point in the season with how bad Philadelphia's offense has looked recently.

news.body: Dallas Goedert caught all four of his targets for 30 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Dallas Goedert catches four balls in Week 8
news.impact: Goedert finished third on the team in receiving in the loss to Washington on Sunday night. The veteran tight end now has 26 catches for 258 yards and two touchdowns in six games this season. He will be a low-end TE1 in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Dallas Goedert hauled in 5-of-7 targets for 48 yards in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Dallas Goedert hauls in five passes Monday
news.impact: The veteran played pretty well on Monday. He hauled in five passes over the course of the game and was able to turn that into 48 yards, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish in most league formats. He will likely continue to be startable moving forward, especially if DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses more time.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (knee) is not taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) not practicing Friday
news.impact: The veteran tight end is not practicing for the Eagles again on Friday. He will have one more chance to log at least a limited practice on Saturday before the team's game on Monday night, but if he's not able to, it's likely that he will be sidelined for the team's primetime matchup against Dallas in Week 7.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) listed doubtful Sunday
news.impact: Kincaid was unable to practice all week. He will likely be ruled out closer to Sunday.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) was not seen practicing for the Buffalo Bills according to Joe Buscaglia.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Kincaid has struggled to reach the practice field for head coach Joe Brady to this point in the week, putting the tight end’s status for Week 11 in serious jeopardy. Dawson Knox would be line for increased snaps in a TE1 role if Kincaid is unable to suit up Sunday.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid was not seen practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) not seen practicing Thursday
news.impact: Kincaid did not practice on Wednesday either. He will need to be monitored on Friday.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kincaid was a non-participant on Wednesday. He's recovering from a pair of injuries right now, although neither of them seem to be particularly serious. His inconsistencies will make him hard to start in Week 11 even if he's fully healthy, however.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught his only target for 11 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Dalton Schultz comes up with just one catch in Week 11 win
news.impact: For the second straight game, Schultz finished with one reception for 11 yards. His one catch ended up in the end zone last week, however. That was not the case Thursday night, as the veteran TE did very little for fantasy managers who rolled him out there. Schultz has a combined total of four grabs over the last three games, so he is difficult to trust for fantasy purposes right now.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 1-of-2 targets for an 11-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Dalton Schultz hauls in TD in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Schultz failed to catch multiple passes for the first time this season in Sunday's loss. He did, however, make his one reception count, scoring for the first time this season. The veteran TE is averaging four grabs and just over 40 yards per game to this point on the season.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Dalton Schultz catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Schultz didn't see a lot of involvement on Sunday, finishing with just two catches in a win over the Chargers. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be super reliable on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though hew will continue to have value as a streaming option.

news.body: Dalton Schultz caught 5-of-6 targets for 45 yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Dalton Schultz hauls in five passes Sunday
news.impact: Schultz was the safety blanket for C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains a borderline low-end TE1/high-end TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 1-of-3 targets for five yards in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Darnell Washington uninvolved in loss Sunday
news.impact: Washington didn't contribute much on Sunday. He caught just one pass for five yards over the course of the game, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He has week-to-week upside but won't be consistent moving forward.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 3-of-5 targets for 94 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Darnell Washington turns in big gain Sunday
news.impact: Washington found himself wide open for a catch and run of 58 yards. He has his flashes, but he still remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught his only target for a four-yard touchdown in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Darnell Washington brings in touchdown in win
news.impact: Washington now has a touchdown grab in three of the last four games. He's going to continue to be a reliable option down near the goal line, but don't expect a lot of volume most weeks. He's a touchdown-or-bust option.

news.body: Darnell Washington caught 4-of-6 targets for 25 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Darnell Washington finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Washington saw some more opportunity with Pat Freiermuth dealing with a calf injury. He'll remain a touchdown dependent TE2 heading into next week.

news.body: Darren Waller is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Ravens.
news.head: Darren Waller (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Waller got in limited practices on Thursday and Friday. He should be trending towards being good to go for Sunday. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers with Tommy Tremble also expected to play.

news.body: Darren Waller (knee) was active at Friday's practice session.
news.head: Darren Waller (knee) practicing again Friday
news.impact: Waller missed practice back on Wednesday, but he has taken part in each of the last two days. The veteran TE should be good to go Sunday against the Ravens.

news.body: Darren Waller did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Darren Waller (knee) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Waller misses practice to begin the week. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Darren Waller caught 2-of-4 targets for 24 yards in a 20-17 win over the Saints.
news.head: Darren Waller hauls in two passes in Week 10
news.impact: Waller's performance was a massive drop-off from his 8-90-1 line from last week. It will be tough to trust the veteran in Week 11 against Baltimore.

news.body: George Kittle hauled in six of his nine targets for 74 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: George Kittle hauls in six passes in Week 10 win
news.impact: Kittle continues a solid stretch in the San Francisco offense, recording four or more receptions in each of his last eight games. The tight end remains one of the more reliable pass-catchers for head coach Kyle Shanahan ahead of a Week 11 matchup against an aggressive Minnesota Vikings defense.

news.body: George Kittle caught 4-of-7 targets for 58 yards in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.
news.head: George Kittle totals 58 yards Sunday
news.impact: Kittle led the Niners with seven targets. Brock Purdy attempted just 25 passes on the day. Kittle will remain a TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: George Kittle hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 88 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: George Kittle leads 49ers in receiving Sunday
news.impact: With both Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel out, Kittle put up new season highs in receptions, targets, and receiving yards on Sunday. The veteran TE is averaging just under five grabs for more than 60 yards per game with five touchdowns through seven weeks. Kittle remains among the top fantasy assets at TE.

news.body: George Kittle caught five of his eight targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
news.head: George Kittle finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Kittle finished second on the 49ers in receiving yards and catches in the close win on Monday night. The veteran tight end scored his touchdown on an 11-yard pass from Brock Purdy early in the first quarter. Overall, Kittle has 26 catches for 337 yards and five touchdowns through six games for the 49ers. With Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) expected to be held out through the team's Week 8 bye, Kittle will be a top-five fantasy tight end option in Week 7 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Greg Dulcich failed to catch either of his targets in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Greg Dulcich shut out in loss
news.impact: Dulcich has had some promising performances this year, but far too often he's putting up duds. He is best left on waivers.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught two of his four targets for 14 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Greg Dulcich catches two passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Dulcich has seen increased involvement in the Miami passing attack of late, logging four or more targets in each of his last four contests. The tight end remains one of many risky pass-catching options in the Miami offense ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught four of six targets for 43 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Greg Dulcich snags four passes in loss to Pats
news.impact: Funny enough, he had the exact same receiving line as Caleb Douglas, who also had four receptions on six targets for 43 yards. Not only that, but just to mention it for fun, the game's total was 43 points, and the average receiving yards of Miami's top four receivers in this game was 43. Do with that information what you choose, but either way, Dulcich has been on the rise recently, with 5+ targets and 37+ receiving yards in each of the last three games. Not only that, but next week he gets the Lions, who have been one of the best matchups for tight ends so far this year.

news.body: Greg Dulcich is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Greg Dulcich (ankle) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Dulcich will remain a TE2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. secured 7-of-9 targets for 91 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. leads the Browns in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Fannin has now gained more than 90 yards in three of the last four weeks. He was coming off just a two-catch performance going into Week 10, but that included a 39-yard TD. Simply put, the second-year TE has been one of the top fantasy assets at his position in this stretch. The Browns are off in Week 11, but Fannin will be a definite TE1 after that.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Texans.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Fannin will remain a TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Fannin was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still managing a groin issue, but it doesn't seem to be a major threat to his Week 10 availability. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him if he's active this week.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Fannin is on track to be good to go in Week 10 for the Browns. He remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught two of his three targets for 22 yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Hunter Henry goes for 22 yards in Week 10
news.impact: Henry finished third on the Patriots in receiving on a rough day for the offense, especially after Drake Maye was knocked out of the game with an ankle injury in the first quarter. Henry gets a downgrade in fantasy with Maye likely looking at a multi-week absence. The Pats are on bye in Week 11 before a Week 12 matchup vs. the Chargers.

news.body: Hunter Henry is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Henry was limited in practice all week. He will remain a borderline TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Hunter Henry (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Henry was again limited on Thursday. He has been dealing with this foot issue for a little while now, but he was able to play through it last week and seems likely to do so again this week. He could be worth starting in Week 10, as this matchup against the Lions is expected to be a high-scoring affair.

news.body: Hunter Henry was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Hunter Henry (foot) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Henry played through the injury last week. He should be on track to be good to go in Week 10.

news.body: Isaiah Likely is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
news.head: Isaiah Likely (groin) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Likely was unable to practice on Friday. He'll still be good to go on Sunday where he remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Isaiah Likely is dealing with a “minor” injury.
news.head: Isaiah Likely misses practice Friday due to 'minor' injury
news.impact: Harbaugh said he expects Likely to be okay. It isn't ideal to miss practice on Friday, but he seemingly still has a chance to play on Sunday. He will need to be monitored on the injury report.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught nine of his 11 targets for 127 yards and one touchdown in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Isaiah Likely explodes for 127 yards, one TD in Week 10
news.impact: Likely turned in a huge outing in the loss to Washington on Thursday night. He did most of his damage on a 66-yard TD catch from J.J. McCarthy in the fourth quarter. Likely's impressive first season with the Giants continues as he now has 55 catches for 575 yards and seven touchdowns in nine games. He will be a locked-in TE1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Isaiah Likely hauled in 5-of-6 targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Likely was able to finish with a good stat line on Sunday. He racked up 53 yards and was able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a good fantasy total on the day. He should continue to be started moving forward, though he is prone to having a bad game here or there with how New York's is currently being operated.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught 2-of-3 targets for 28 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Juwan Johnson hauls in two passes in Week 10
news.impact: Johnson continues to see a consistent target share, but has quickly become a forgotten part of the Saints' passing attack. Fantasy managers can find a better option heading into Week 11.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught both of his targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Juwan Johnson snags touchdown in win over Browns
news.impact: Johnson had struggled to get much of anything going over the last few weeks, and Sunday was much the same aside from a touchdown that saved his fantasy day. He might have some better luck moving foward, but he's best left on the bench for now.

news.body: Juwan Johnson caught just one of three targets for seven yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday,
news.head: Juwan Johnson held in check on Sunday
news.impact: Johnson started the season off hot, but has only five catches for 23 yards in the past three weeks, with four of those receptions and 16 of the yards coming in one game. With Jordyn Tyson expected to return after the bye, Johnson could find himself buried even further.

news.body: Juwan Johnson did not catch either of his two targets in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Juwan Johnson does not haul in pass Sunday
news.impact: It was a low-volume passing day for New Orleans. Johnson will look to bounce back next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught four of his five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. catches four passes in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Pitts Sr. has struggled to make a consistent impact on offense to this point, finishing with less than 60 receiving yards in nine of 10 games. The tight end remains a risky pass-catching option in an inconsistent Atlanta offense for head coach Kevin Stefanski entering the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 3-of-5 targets for 23 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in three passes in Week 9
news.impact: Pitts has seen a steady volume of targets, logging at least five in five straight games. Despite that, Pitts has not eclipsed more than 23 yards in any of his last three games. Pitts andn the Falcons will take on the Chiefs in Week 10.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. He will remain a TE2 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in all five of his targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hits paydirt again in Week 7 win
news.impact: For those who were patient with Pitts after a very slow start this season, the rewards have come over the last three weeks. The towering tight end has now scored four times during that span, catching exactly five passes each time out.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught eight passes for 82 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Mark Andrews leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Andrews had a good game on Monday night. He led the team in receptions and receiving yards in this loss to the Chargers, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all to cap it off. We saw QB Jacoby Brissett hyper-target the TE position when he was in Arizona earlier in the year, so Andrews could be a worthwhile streaming option if that trend now continues in Baltimore, as it did on Monday.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Mark Andrews snags two passes in loss
news.impact: Andrews led the Ravens in receiving yards in the blowout loss, not that it meant much for fantasy. He's been tough to trust at any point this season and is safe to leave on the waiver wire. However, if you want to hold on and see what he might do with Jacoby Brissett at QB, there's merit to that.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 3-of-4 targets for 14 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Mark Andrews hauls in three passes in Week 8
news.impact: Andrews continues to see at least three targets a game this season. With the potential of rookie Joe Fagano starting in Week 9, Andrews may be in line for more work as a security option in the passing game against Jacksonville.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Mark Andrews hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Andrews led the tight end group in targets and receptions in the loss to the Bengals. Andrews has not seen the same target share with Tyler Huntley at quarterback, so it would be a welcome sight for fantasy managers if Lamar Jackson is able to play in Week 8.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught 2-of-3 targets for 16 yards in the Raiders 21-13 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Michael Mayer catches two passes Sunday
news.impact: Mayer could be a streaming option moving forward if Brock Bowers (ankle) is set to miss time.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards in the Raiders 38-17 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in three passes Sunday
news.impact: Mayer nearly found the end zone, but he lost a fumble at the goal line. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught 5-of-6 targets for 53 yards in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in five passes in Week 8
news.impact: Mayer and Brock Bowers led the Raiders' pass catchers, accounting for 16 of Kirk Cousins' 26 pass attempts. Mayer remains a solid option in deeper leagues with the Raiders' continuing to deploy both tight ends.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught all three of his targets for 32 yards in the Raiders’ 35-21 loss to the Rams in Week 7.
news.head: Michael Mayer catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Mayer has seen inconsistent involvement in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, receiving three targets or less in three of his last five contests. The tight end remains difficult to trust in all formats as long as Brock Bowers remains healthy, with a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets up next.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 1-of-2 targets for nine yards in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Mike Gesicki quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: Cincinnati's offense was unstoppable on Sunday night, but Gesicki wasn't able to get in on that. He finished with just one catch for nine yards, so he obviously had a disappointing fantasy total as well. He has decent streaming upside on a week-to-week basis but won't be consistent moving forward.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught both of his targets for 11 yards in a 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Mike Gesicki hauls in two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Gesicki had a streak of five straight games with a touchdown snapped Sunday. The veteran tight end had not logged a lot of receptions, but had provided fantasy managers with plenty of trips to the end zone. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught four of his six targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Mike Gesicki catches TD in Week 8
news.impact: Gesicki had a big afternoon in the Bengals' first game since losing Erick All to a torn ACL. He has now caught a touchdown in all six of his games played this season. Gesicki will be a high-end TE2 in Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught his lone target for six yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Mike Gesicki hits pay dirt in Week 7
news.impact: Gesicki found the end zone in the third quarter to open the scoring for the Bengals on their way to a comeback win. The veteran tight end has five touchdowns in six games so far this season. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth was a meaningful contributor for the Steelers on Sunday. He hauled in a touchdown on one of his two catches and racked up 35 yards in the process. He will continue to be fantasy relevant moving forward, although he's not immune from having bad games on a game-to-game basis.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth (illness) is active for Week 10 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (illness) active for Week 10
news.impact: Freiermuth is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation with a late-week illness, providing quarterback Aaron Rodgers with his inconsistent TE1 against the Bengals Sunday night.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth is now listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Bengals.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (illness) now questionable Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth is a late addition to the injury report due to an illness. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-2 targets for 35 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth scores touchdown on ground Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth scored a touchdown at the goal line on a tush push. His upside remains limited as a pass catcher. He is a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught one of his four targets for 16 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Sam LaPorta held to one catch in Week 10
news.impact: LaPorta's mid-season lull continues as he's caught just 10 passes for 99 scoreless yards over his past four contests. The veteran tight end will look to get it going in Week 11's matchup vs. the Buccaneers, but he needs to be treated as a high-end TE2 in fantasy going forward until he starts producing more on the field.

news.body: The Lions have reportedly received calls on TE Sam LaPorta.
news.head: Sam LaPorta receiving trade interest, not expected to be moved
news.impact: Fowler notes that teams have gotten the impression that Detroit "would like to keep him and try to work out a long-terms deal eventually." It appears LaPorta is likely to remain in Detroit long-term.

news.body: Sam LaPorta hauled in four of his five targets for 32 yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Sam LaPorta sees five targets in Week 9 win
news.impact: LaPorta remains consistently involved in the Detroit passing attack of late, recording five or more targets in four of his last five contests. The tight end remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of a prolific Detroit offense heading into a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught three of his five targets for 33 yards while also rushing once for two yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
news.head: Sam LaPorta quiet in Week 8 win
news.impact: LaPorta has struggled to make an impact on offense of late, recording less than 35 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The tight end will look to get back on track against an underwhelming Miami Dolphins defense in Week 9.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) will be added to the active roster, but is not close to returning to the field for the Los Angeles Rams according to Adam Grosbard.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) to be activated, remain sidelined
news.impact: Ferguson continues to work back from multiple injuries, but due to the numerous injury issues facing the Los Angeles Rams, the organization will shuffle the tight end back to the active roster. He can remain off rosters in all formats while continuing his rehab.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Ferguson will remain sidelined as expected after he re-aggravated his hamstring injury last week.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Ferguson is on track to remain sidelined for Sunday's game against the Cardinals for the Rams.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson did not practice in Wednesday’s walk-through.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Rams head coach Sean McVay said earlier this week that Ferguson is likely out a couple weeks after re-aggravating his hamstring injury last week.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson is off the injury report for Sunday against the 49ers.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson was able to return to practice all week. He'll be a low-end TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Hockenson logged his second straight limited practice. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was officially a limited participant on Wednesday, as he's currently managing a wrist issue of some kind. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 11, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) was participating at Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) participating at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was able to take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday. That bodes well for his Week 11 availability, but we won't get more information until the team releases their first official practice report of the week later today.

news.body: Travis Kelce (ankle) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Kelce's ankle injury isn't serious right now and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He may be a decent fantasy option in PPR formats this week, although we haven't seen a high week-to-week ceiling for him so far this season.

news.body: Travis Kelce hauled in both of his targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons in Week 10.
news.head: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 10 win
news.impact: Kelce was hampered by a lingering ankle injury, exiting briefly on his way to finishing with less than four receptions for the first time in his last five games. The tight end will look to get back on track against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11.

news.body: Travis Kelce (ankle) is headed to the locker room for the Kansas City Chiefs according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) heads to locker room Sunday
news.impact: Kelce limped off the field in the first quarter after being tackled, hauling in his only target for 23 yards prior to exiting. Noah Gray will take over the TE1 role as long as Kelce remains sidelined.

news.body: Travis Kelce (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Kelce was able to practice all week and will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Falcons. He will continue to be a safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis, though his ceiling isn't all that high at this point in his career.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 5-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.
news.head: Trey McBride catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride was a safety blanket for Carson Beck in his NFL debut as a starter. He remains a steady high-end TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 7-of-8 targets for 54 yards in the Cardinals 17-3 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride nearly hauled in a touchdown late in the loss, but the pass was knocked away by Nick Emmanwori late in the fourth quarter. McBride remains a locked and loaded elite high-end TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in seven of his eight targets for 72 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Trey McBride finds end zone in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: McBride has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a receiving touchdown in three of his last four contests. The tight end remains locked in as a reliable TE1 option ahead of a Week 9 matchup against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 9.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 10 of 13 targets for 111 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Trey McBride Goes Over 100 Yards, Scores in Week 7
news.impact: McBride accounted for 10 of Jacoby Brissett's 27 completions and 111 of his 272 passing yards. He also caught Arizona's only touchdown, scoring from seven yards out in the third quarter. With 13 targets and no other Cardinal seeing more than eight, McBride remains one of fantasy football's safest elite TE1 options.

news.body: Tyler Warren came up with just 1-of-5 targets for 22 yards in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Tyler Warren hauls in one pass Thursday night
news.impact: Warren's frustrating sophomore season in the NFL continued Thursday night. He did have a nice 22-yard gain, but other than that, he was shut down. Warren has managed only 11 total receptions over the last four games and has not scored since Week 2. The Colts' passing game is a mess right now, and Warren's fantasy value has greatly suffered as a result.

news.body: Tyler Warren caught two of three targets for one yard and ran once for three yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Tyler Warren quiet in win over the Dolphins
news.impact: Warren found some new lows in a season of low points. Earlier in the season, he was helped out by touchdowns, but he last scored in Week 2. He's had some decent yardage games, but also some low totals. QB Daniel Jones is largely to blame here, though Warren himself isn't doing as much on his touches as he did last year.

news.body: Tyler Warren caught four of his seven targets for 44 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Tyler Warren catches four balls in Week 9
news.impact: Warren finished second on the team in receiving and catches in the close loss to Dallas. The second-year tight end is putting together a quiet sophomore season, posting 38 catches for 275 yards and two touchdowns in seven games. He will settle in as a high-end TE2 in Week 10 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Tyler Warren managed to catch just 4-of-10 targets for only 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Tyler Warren struggles in return from injury
news.impact: After missing each of the last two games due to a groin injury, Warren was back on the field for the Colts in Week 8. It didn't make much of a difference, however, as the second-year TE struggled in what was a terrible performance from the Colts on the whole. Warren's production should improve from here, but the Colts' offense is a difficult one to trust.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell caught 3-of-8 targets for 59 yards in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell logs three receptions in Week 10
news.impact: Mitchell was second on the team in targets, but well behind Garrett Wilson's 14 targets. With Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) exiting early, Mitchell could be in line for a similar target share in Week 11 if Cooper is unable to suit up.

news.body: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (knee) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (knee) officially active for Week 10
news.impact: Mitchell was a late add to the injury report this week but is cleared to play. Mitchell, Omar Cooper Jr., and Garrett Wilson are all active for the Jets.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell is expected to play on Sunday against the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (knee) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Mitchell was added to the injury report on Friday, but he still got in a full practice. He is a big play dependent WR3/flex play with Garrett Wilson and Omar Cooper Jr. also expected to play.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Bills.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Mitchell was added to the injury report on Friday, but he was still able to log a full practice. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

news.body: AJ Brown is expected to miss multiple weeks due to his hamstring injury.
news.head: A.J. Brown (hamstring) to miss multiple weeks
news.impact: It is another injury for Brown that will sideline him at least two more games. It is unclear if a stint on injured reserve is being considered.

news.body: A.J. Brown (hamstring) is questionable to return for the New England Patriots Sunday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (hamstring) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Brown exits after catching just two of his six targets for 27 yards in a disastrous game for the New England offense as a whole. The wideout may remain sidelined with the Patriots trailing 28-3 beginning the fourth quarter.

news.body: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) is officially active for Week 10 for the New England Patriots against the Detroit Lions according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) active for Week 10
news.impact: Brown is good to go after carrying a questionable designation into the weekend, passing through pregame activities without any setbacks. The dynamic wideout will look to offer quarterback Drake Maye an impactful pass-catching option against an inconsistent Detroit secondary Sunday.

news.body: A.J. Brown is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Lions.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Brown was limited in practice all week. He will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught four of his five targets for 98 yards and a touchdown in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown scores twice in Week 10
news.impact: St. Brown snapped a five-game scoreless streak by finding the end zone twice, on catches of 56 and 28 yards. The star wideout now has 65 catches for 755 yards and seven touchdowns through nine games. He will be a top-three fantasy wideout in Week 11 vs. Tampa Bay.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is officially active for Week 10 for the Detroit Lions against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) active for Week 10
news.impact: St. Brown is good to go after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation for head coach Dan Campbell, boosting an explosive Detroit offensive attack as a reliable WR1 option against the Patriots in Germany Sunday.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Patriots.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: St. Brown was limited in practice all week. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) limited again Thursday
news.impact: St. Brown was limited at a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still managing a rib issue of some kind, but he played through it last week and seems likely to do the same again in Week 10. Fantasy managers shouldn't be concerned with his availability for Sunday's game unless he carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught both of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Antonio Williams scores TD in Week 10 win
news.impact: Williams hauled in a 31-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels in the third quarter. Unfortunately, he only drew two targets on a night when Daniels spread the ball around. Williams has shown explosive play-making potential in his rookie year, but he will need more targets to be fully trustworthy in fantasy leagues. Williams will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Antonio Williams had three catches for 25 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Antonio Williams has three catches in loss
news.impact: Williams has now put together his fifth straight game with at least three receptions. Williams has shown promising flashes of talent, and still has the chance to become the de-facto number one receiver in the Commanders' offense. He faces the Giants on Thursday Night Football where he will be in WR3/Flex range with high upside.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught five of his seven targets for 54 yards in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Antonio Williams goes for 54 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Williams moved into a starting role with the Commanders playing their first game since losing Terry McLaurin to a season-ending knee injury. The rookie responded well, finishing second on the team in receiving yards while leading the way with seven targets. Williams becomes interesting in fantasy moving forward as he gears up to take on the Rams in Week 9.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught three of his four targets for 50 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Antonio Williams finishes with 50 receiving yards in Week 6
news.impact: Williams finished third on the team in receiving in the loss on Monday night. The rookie wideout has shown flashes this season but his role hasn't been large enough to be trusted as a weekly starter in fantasy. He could see more work after his bye in Week 7, after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field during Monday night's game against the 49ers. Williams is worth a waiver claim in most leagues this week.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, as his shoulder injury isn't considered to be anything more than a minor issue at this point. He has week-to-week fantasy upside, but his weekly floor is also somewhat low with how bad Miami's offense has looked lately.

news.body: Caleb Douglas was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Douglas remained limited in practice. He will have a chance to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Bills.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) was limited at Miami's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie was limited for Miami's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's listed with a shoulder injury of some kind, but it's not though to be more than a minor issue at this point. He should play through it and continue to be a viable streaming option in most league formats this week.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught three of eight targets for 71 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas racks up 71 yards in loss
news.impact: Douglas's 71 yards are a welcome sight, especially on just three catches. It's unfortunate his day could have been much bigger given the eight targets. Next week he gets a tougher challenge against Buffalo.

news.body: Carnell Tate is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against Cowboys.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Tate was able to practice all week, including a full practice on Friday. He is trending towards returning on Sunday.

news.body: Carnell Tate (shoulder) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Tate was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a shoulder issue. It looks likely that he will play this week, but fantasy managers should pay attention to the team's official injury report on Friday, as that should give us clarity on what his status is looking like heading into the weekend.

news.body: Carnell Tate (shoulder) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: Tate was officially a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise. It looks like he's trending towards playing this week and could have some real fantasy value over the back half of the season if Tennessee's offense can continue to improve.

news.body: Carnell Tate is practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) practicing Wednesday
news.impact: It is a good sign for Tate who last played in Week 7. He remains hopeful to return in Week 11 for the Titans.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his 13 targets for 73 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-30 Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb finds end zone in Week 10 loss to 49ers
news.impact: Lamb has caught fire on offense of late, finishing with over 70 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in three of his last four games. The pass-catcher remains one of the more dynamic WR1 options for fantasy managers ahead of a generous Week 11 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught 10 of his 16 targets for 195 yards and a touchdown in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb goes for 195 yards, TD in Week 9
news.impact: Lamb lost a fumble early in the fourth quarter after making a spectacular catch for a 48-yard gain, the only blemish in an otherwise exceptional performance. The veteran wideout continues to post big numbers for the Cowboys, catching 70 balls for 904 yards and seven touchdowns through nine games. He will be a locked-in WR1 in Week 10 vs. the 49ers.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in seven of his team-high 11 targets for 58 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb leads pass-catchers in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Lamb was held mostly in check Sunday, finishing under 60 receiving yards for the first time in his last three contests. The wideout remains locked in as an elite WR1 option against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in two touchdowns Monday
news.impact: Lamb wasn't able to connect with Prescott on over half of his targets, but he was able to make the most out of the ones that he did catch, finishing with 74 yards and two touchdowns in a comfortable win over the Eagles. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, assuming he remains healthy.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught two of his three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard run in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches two passes in Week 9
news.impact: Godwin was quiet in the loss in what has been a disappointing year for him. He is still looking for his first touchdown of the season while failing to go over 46 receiving yards in any of his nine games. Droppable in 12-team leagues, Godwin will be on bye in Week 10 before he takes on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. did not catch his lone target in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. does not catch pass Sunday
news.impact: Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass in the win on Sunday. Godwin has struggled all season regardless of the circumstances. He'll be a WR4/WR5 moving forward.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes in win
news.impact: While the final stat line is a bit disappointing considering Emeka Egbuka did not play, it's important to remember Baker Mayfield threw only 11 passes for 64 yards. Godwin had a 45% target share and a 42% receiving yards share with those numbers. So again, nothing much to write home about in the final box score, but his actual market share was great. He could be interesting next week against the Falcons

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 4-of-8 targets for 37 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: Godwin was second on the team in targets, but it didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 3-of-4 targets for 30 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Chris Olave quiet in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Olave's four targets are his lowest of the season. The 26-year-old saw Jordyn Tyson dominate the target share against the Panthers. Olave will look to bounce back against the Bears in Week 11.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 7 of 12 targets for 98 yards in the Saints' 23-22 overtime win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave sees 12 targets in win over Browns
news.impact: Olave was hard at work in this one, more than doubling up the next closest Saint in targets, which was rookie Jordyn Tyson. He also nearly doubled up the next closest Saint in yardage and had three more receptions than any other. It was his best yardage total in a month, and he will look to keep things up against the Panthers next week.

news.body: Chris Olave caught six of ten targets for 56 yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave snags 6 passes in loss
news.impact: Olave was second on the team in receiving yards by one, but led in targets by three over RB Alvin Kamara. It wasn't the game we would have hoped for Olave, but it certainly wasn't something that ruined your week. He's been quiet over the last three weeks, aside from a touchdown last Sunday. He will look to have better results against Cleveland after the Saints' bye.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 4-of-7 targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge day for Olave, but he made up for it with a touchdown. He will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Christian Watson caught three of his five targets for 37 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
news.head: Christian Watson bottled up in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Watson was held in check by a stout Minnesota defense, being held to less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in six games. The wideout will look to return to his impactful form for fantasy managers after the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Christian Watson hauled in seven of his eight targets for 171 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson finds end zone in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Watson has been impactful in the Green Bay offense of late, recording over 115 receiving yards in three of his last five games. The wideout remains one of the few dynamic offensive options in the Green Bay offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Watson suffered a broken rib last week, but it's not going to prevent him from playing this week and he is officially good to go for Sunday's game. Fantasy managers should feel confident starting him this week in what projects to be a high-scoring affair in New England this weekend.

news.body: Christian Watson remained limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Watson is continuing to trend towards being good to go for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Sutton scored from three yards out in the first quarter for his first touchdown since Week 1. He also led Denver with nine targets, nearly doubling his four targets from Week 8. That's the good. The bad? Sutton still hasn't surpassed 60 receiving yards in a game this season. The touchdown helps, but one productive fantasy performance doesn't erase eight weeks of limited production.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught all four of his targets for 53 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Courtland Sutton records 53 receiving yards in Week 8
news.impact: Sutton's 53 yards were his most since Week 2. That's the good. The bad? He saw only four targets and has now gone seven straight games without a touchdown. One improved performance doesn't change what Sutton has been through eight weeks. He remains difficult to start outside of deeper leagues.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught three of five targets for 45 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Courtland Sutton Held to 45 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Sutton averaged 15 yards per reception but wasn't involved in either of Bo Nix's explosive touchdowns. He also finished behind Jaylen Waddle in targets for the second straight week. Sutton isn't a viable fantasy starter. Denver's expanding group of playmakers make his weekly production volatile.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches two passes in win
news.impact: Sutton was quiet in this game, though there wasn't much to go around when the team combined for 107 passing yards. It's been a rough start to the year for QB Bo Nix, and until he improves, the pass catchers will suffer.

news.body: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return in Week 13 for the Los Angeles Rams according to Michael J. Duarte.
news.head: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return Week 13
news.impact: Adams continues to recover from hamstring surgery, but has progressed enough to potentially return sooner than later for a shorthanded Rams passing attack.
