The veteran wideout would slide into a WR1 role for head coach Sean McVay with Puka Nacua potentially out for the remainder of the season upon his return.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
news.head: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
news.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

news.body: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.head: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

news.body: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. hauled in all three of his targets for 31 yards and one touchdown while also rushing three times for a team-high 78 yards and one touchdown in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. scores two touchdowns in Week 10 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Samuel Sr. has had a nose for the end zone of late, scoring at least one touchdown in three of his last four contests. The veteran wideout will look to remain one of the more impactful offensive options for the 49ers ahead of a Week 11 matchup against a strong Minnesota Vikings defense.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Samuel is officially good to go. He will be an upside WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Samuel will have a chance to return on Sunday against the Cowboys. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) is expected to return to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to be limited Wednesday
news.impact: Samuel has been out for a while due to a nagging hamstring issue, but he is going to return to practice on Wednesday and is expected to be a limited participant. He will have a chance to play in Week 10, but we won't know his status for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught one of his three targets for four yards in a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: DeMario Douglas held to one catch in Week 10
news.impact: Douglas had been trending up coming into the game as he had four touchdowns in his previous five contests. The entire New England pass-catching corps is likely to take a hit with Drake Maye (ankle) looking at a multi-week absence. Douglas will look to bounce back in Week 12 vs. the Chargers after his bye next week.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 5-of-9 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Douglas was a bright spot for the Patriots on Sunday. He led the team with 102 yards on five catches, which left him with a good fantasy total despite him not getting into the end zone at all. He will continue to be a viable fantasy option for as long as A.J. Brown (knee) remains out of the lineup moving forward.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads Patriots WRs in win
news.impact: Douglas led the Patriots in receiving yards and tied for third on the team in targets with two other players: Hunter Henry and Rhamondre Stevenson. Douglas made his targets count, though, with a 48 yard score being the highlight of his night. Should AJ Brown continue to miss time, Douglas seems to be a safe bet for targets and production.

news.body: DeMario Douglas brought in 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: DeMario Douglas catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas delivered back-to-back big games in Week and Week 6, but he fell back down to Earth against the Bears. Drake Maye heavily relied on his running backs and tight ends Thursday night, not leaving much for Douglas behind fellow wideout A.J. Brown. Douglas may have already had his best games of the season and will likely be tough to rely on for fantasy purposes going forward this season.

news.body: Denzel Boston caught 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.head: Denzel Boston finishes with just one catch in Week 10
news.impact: Boston dealt with a toe injury all week, but he practiced Friday and took the field Sunday. The rookie was not able to produce much for fantasy managers, however, finishing with fewer than three catches for just the second time over the last seven games. Boston has had a nice rookie season to this point and should rebound quickly.

news.body: Browns WR Denzel Boston (toe) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup with Houston.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) officially active for Week 10
news.impact: Boston was able to return to practice Friday and has been cleared to suit up against the Texans. Deshaun Watson will have one of his top pass catchers against a solid Houston defense.

news.body: Denzel Boston is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Texans.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Boston returned to practice on Friday after two straight absences. He'll need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

news.body: Denzel Boston returned to practice on Friday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (toe) back at practice Friday
news.impact: Boston did not practice on Wednesday or Thursday. He'll have a chance to be good to go on Sunday.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught both of his targets for 14 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Devaughn Vele logs two receptions in Week 10
news.impact: Vele has seen his target share drop since the debut of Jordyn Tyson. Fantasy managers can leave Vele out of their lineup for now.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught two of four targets for 17 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags two passes in win
news.impact: Vele was one of eight Saints players to catch a pass on Sunday, and he was tied for fourth in receptions. It's gonna be tough for Vele to find relevance with Jordyn Tyson now in the mix, so he can be dropped in most leagues.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags touchdown in loss
news.impact: Vele caught the Saints' only touchdown in this game, very much helping out his final fantasy line. He was one of four Saints to finish between 57 and 54 receiving yards, joining Barion Brown, Alvin Kamara, and Chris Olave. Vele has been a great waiver pickup for the first half of the season, but with the Saints going on bye and Jordyn Tyson expected back soon after it, it could be tough for Vele to have much relevance moving forward.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 3-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Devaughn Vele totals 42 yards Sunday
news.impact: Vele was the second-leading receiver on the day for New Orleans. He is a borderline flex play in games where the passing volume is low for the Saints.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Smith will be back in the lineup on Sunday after missing some time with a hamstring injury. His presence should be a nice boost for Philadelphia's offense moving forward, but he himself will likely be an inconsistent fantasy option with Joe Milton III currently the starting quarterback for the Eagles.

news.body: DeVonta Smith is practicing again on Thursday.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) practicing Thursday
news.impact: Smith continues to trend towards returning this week. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) was seen participating at Philadelphia's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) seen practicing Wednesday
news.impact: There was a recent report that Smith may make his return to the lineup in Week 11, and he was seen taking part in Philadelphia's first practice of the week on Wednesday, which is further evidence of that. The Eagles offense will be much more competent if he's able to suit up and play against the Steelers this week.

news.body: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said he feels “pretty good” about DeVonta Smith returning for Week 11 against the Steelers.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) could return in Week 11
news.impact: Smith hasn’t played since Week 6 because of the hamstring issue. He'll need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 4-of-6 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He rushed for four yards on one attempt.
news.head: DJ Moore finds the end zone in Week 10 win
news.impact: Moore hauled in a 45-yard touchdown reception late in the third quarter to push the Bills' lead to 12. This was a solid bounce back after only accounting for 25 receiving yards against the Vikings. Moore and the Bills will take on the Dolphins in Week 11.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards, adding 11 yards on one carry in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: DJ Moore totals 36 yards in Monday's win
news.impact: Moore had a big game in his return to action against the Ravens in Week 8. He couldn't replicate the effort in Week 9, but he is healthy and stronger fantasy performances should be on the way. Moore is best viewed as a low-end WR2 or high-end WR3.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 4-of-7 targets for 82 yards and a touchdown in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: DJ Moore hauls in TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Moore found the end zone on an 11-yard reception early in the fourth quarter. Moore did indicate after the game that he was fine after leaving the game late with a knee injury. Moore and the Bills take on the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is officially active for Week 8 for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) active for Week 8
news.impact: Moore is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, boosting a Buffalo passing attack for quarterback Josh Allen against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 2-of-6 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: DK Metcalf leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf ended the game with just two catches, but he was productive with them and was able to finish with 54 yards and a touchdown on the night. His fantasy total was decent in this matchup, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be consistent on a game-to-game basis over the back half of the season.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 1-of-6 targets for four yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: DK Metcalf drops pass that leads to interception Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf dropped an open pass that was going for over 30 yards. He not only dropped the pass, but the ball also bounced off him and resulted in an interception. He is an upside WR3 with a low floor for fantasy managers.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught two of six targets for 56 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in big 51 yarder in win
news.impact: Metcalf has been very up and down this season, with a big 115 yard performance against Cleveland followed up by 12 yards the following week, then an 11-for-93 stat line last Sunday, and finally two for 56 this Sunday. He's a boom-bust receiver for now; if you can afford to let him have his ups and downs, then he's a fine start. But more than likely, he's a risky flex at best.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 11-of-15 targets for 93 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf took over late as he totaled 12 targets in the fourth quarter and overtime period alone. He'll remain in the WR2/WR3 range with both Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR.

news.body: Drake London hauled in six of his team-leading 12 targets for 109 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Drake London surpasses 100 yards in Week 10 loss to Chiefs
news.impact: London has made the most of inconsistent quarterback play, registering five or more receptions in five of his last seven contests. The wideout remains one of the few impactful options on offense for head coach Kevin Stefanski as the team enters its bye week.

news.body: Drake London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in a 34-17 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Drake London hauls in five passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: London lead the Falcons in receiving yards in the loss Sunday. London has been held in check over the last two weeks, posting just 76 receiving yards on six receptions. London and the Falcons will look to bounce back against the Chiefs in Week 10.

news.body: Drake London caught 1-of-6 targets for eight yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Drake London catches one pass Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense as Michael Penix Jr. completed just eight passes all day and threw four interceptions. London remains a WR1 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Drake London hauls in a touchdown during Week 7 win
news.impact: London finally hit paydirt this season. He's having a great season, but the end zone had simply eluded the fifth-year star over the first six weeks of the campaign. That changed in the fourth quarter of Sunday's upset of the 49ers. London is now averaging 5.4 receptions and 88 yards per game. He is a certain WR1 for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught 5 of 10 targets for 79 yards in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor goes for 79 yards in loss to Jags
news.impact: Ayomanor has seen 7, 5, and 10 targets in the last three weeks, with 44, 34, and now 79 yards to show for it. It's a bit inefficient; he's caught only 50% of his targets in that span, but nothing terrible in terms of yardage. He's a flex play at best, but only in deep formats.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught three of his five targets for 34 yards in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor goes for 34 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Ayomanor failed to capitalize on Carnell Tate's absence while Chimere Dike and Gunnar Helm led the way in receiving. The second-year wideout has now caught 13 passes for 211 yards and one touchdown in eight games. He will be on his bye in Week 9.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught three of his seven targets for 44 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor goes for 44 yards in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Ayomanor tied with Carnell Tate for the team lead with seven targets. The three catches go down as Ayomanor's best effort of the season as he's been held to just one catch in five of seven games. He will not be a strong fantasy play heading into Week 8 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught his lone target for 22 yards in the Titans loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor held to one reception in Week 4
news.impact: Ayomanor continues to see a limited target share in his second season in the NFL. The 23-year-old would likely need an injury to Carnell Tate or Wan'Dale Robinson to become an option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka caught three of his five targets for 38 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Bears in Week 9. He also gained one yard on his lone rush in the loss.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka hauls in three passes in Week 9
news.impact: Egbuka was dealing with a foot injury throughout the week and was listed as questionable for the game before ultimately suiting up. The second-year wideout has 31 catches for 278 yards and two touchdowns in seven games this season. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Lions in Week 11.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play in Sunday’s matchup between night’s matchup between the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Chicago Bears according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka progressed enough throughout the week after being limited to entering it, as the wideout looks to provide quarterback Baker Mayfield with an impactful pass-catching option against the Chicago Bears Sunday night.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (foot) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) officially questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka will head into the weekend with a questionable tag. It seems like there's a lot of optimism surrounding his status, but he is officially considered questionable to play at this point. It may be hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him this week, however, especially with him playing on Sunday night after the main slate of games.

news.body: Bucs coach Todd Bowles said Emeka Egbuka will be a game-time decision on Sunday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (foot) to be game-time decision Sunday
news.impact: Egbuka was able to return to a full practice on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into the weekend.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught 7-of-14 targets for 106 yards in a 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson eclipses 100 receiving yards in Week 10
news.impact: Wilson led the team in all receiving categories and logged a season high 14 targets in his return from a one game absence. The Jets did lose QB Geno Smtih to an ankle injury, so Wilson could be catching passes from rookie Cade Klubnik again in Week 11 against the Chargers.

news.body: Jets WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) is officially active for a Week 10 matchup for the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) officially active for Week 10
news.impact: Wilson was listed as questionable to play but has cleared concussion protocol in time to suit up against Buffalo. Wilson will likely lead the Jets' passing attack, with Omar Cooper Jr. and Adonai Mitchell also seeing time alongside the Jets' WR1.

news.body: Garrett Wilson is expected to play on Sunday against the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Wilson has been trending in the right direction all week. He should be good to go after being sidelined last week.

news.body: Garrett Wilson is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Bills.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Wilson ended the week with a full practice. He remains on track to clear concussion protocol and be good to go for Sunday.

news.body: George Pickens hauled in 11 of his team-leading 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 Week 10 loss to the 49ers.
news.head: George Pickens hauls in three touchdowns in Week 10 loss to 49ers
news.impact: Pickens has found his way to the end zone of late, scoring one or more touchdowns in three of his last five games. The wideout offers fantasy managers one of the more impactful pass-catching options ahead of a favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: George Pickens (hamstring) is officially active for Week 10 for the Dallas Cowboys against the San Francisco 49ers according to Joe Hoyt.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) active for Week 10
news.impact: Pickens is good to go after passing through pregame tests without any issues, boosting a Dallas passing attack that will be without TE1 Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) against the 49ers Sunday.

news.body: George Pickens practiced again on Friday.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) practices Friday
news.impact: Pickens remained limited in practice on Thursday. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.body: George Pickens (hamstring) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: George Pickens (hamstring) limited again Thursday
news.impact: The Cowboys were without Pickens last week due to a hamstring injury, and it left him limited for another practice on Thursday as well. He could be sidelined for another game on Sunday, but we won't know his official game status until sometime after practice on Friday.

news.body: Germie Bernard didn't haul in any of his three targets in Sunday's 38-18 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Germie Bernard held without catch in loss Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was locked down on Sunday night. He saw three targets over the course of the game but couldn't haul in any of them, leaving him with a goose egg in most categories on the stat sheet. He should not be started in any league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 5-of-5 targets for 30 yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Germie Bernard catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Bernard hauled in all five targets that went his way. He remains in the WR3/WR4 range for fantasy managers while Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson both remain sidelined.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught three of five targets for 27 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Germie Bernard snags three passes in win over Saints
news.impact: After two great weeks in a row, Bernard was largely held in check by the Saints defense in this one, limited to three short yardage catches. There will be better days ahead, but one thing to keep note of is that the Steelers will have to start getting him some space downfield rather than the short dink-and-dunk targets he's had recently.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 11-of-12 targets for 87 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Germie Bernard finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Bernard took full advantage of his extended opportunity with both Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. on injured reserve. He scored the wining touchdown in OT as well that he hauled in from Aaron Rodgers. He'll be on the WR3/flex range heading into next week against the Titans.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-11 targets for 61 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane solid in loss Monday
news.impact: The rookie saw the most targets out of anybody on the team on Monday night. He was only able to bring in three of them, however, but he was still able to finish with a solid 61 yards over the course of the game. He will have fantasy value if he continues to be targeted at this rate moving forward, but that's far from a guarantee.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane was held without a catch in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held without a catch in loss
news.impact: Lane has only one catch in the last two games, but it's hard to take away much from Thursday's game, where the Ravens only had 10 completions, and their leading receiver had only 19 yards. So don't lose hope on Lane just yet.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught his lone target for 13 yards in a 36-10 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Lane's one target sets a new season low for the rookie. The passing attack was clearly not the same after losing both Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Lane and the passing game to struggle if Huntley is unable to play in Week 9.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Lane has logged five targets in two straight games since returning from injury. Fantasy managers should expect the rookie to continue to get plenty of opportunities in the Ravens' passing attack.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) set to play Sunday
news.impact: As expected, the veteran wideout will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Jacksonville's injury report throughout the week with an ankle issue. Meyers will continue to play his usual role in Week 11 and beyond.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) limited again Thursday
news.impact: As expected, the team left Meyers limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from an ankle issue. He should play and continue to see his usual workload in Week 11, however.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was listed as limited on the team's first injury report of the week on Wednesday. He has been managing this ankle issue for a little while already, but he has played through it recently and is expected to do so again on Sunday.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught three of six targets for 34 yards in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers goes for 34 yards in win
news.impact: Meyers was third on the team in yards and in a four way tie for second in receptions, but even with Trevor Lawrence throwing for 352 yards, it didn't mean much for Meyers with the ball being so spread out. He's certainly capable of usable fantasy performances, but it seems on an every-other-week sort of basis right now.

news.body: Jalen Coker did not record a reception on four targets in a 20-17 win over the Saints. He tallied three rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Jalen Coker fails to record a reception in Week 10
news.impact: Coker was held without a reception for the first time this season. Coker is dealing with a healthy wide receiver and tight end group, which could impact his targets moving forward. Coker and the Panthers will take on the Ravens in Week 11.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught four of five targets for 29 yards while losing three yards on his lone rushing attempt in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
news.head: Jalen Coker records 29 receiving yards in Week 9
news.impact: Coker caught four passes, but averaged just 7.3 yards per reception. Meanwhile, Darren Waller and Tetairoa McMillan combined for 146 receiving yards and two touchdowns. Coker continues to receive opportunities, but his production isn't enough to warrant a fantasy start in shallow leagues.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just 2-of-5 targets for 36 yards, but scored a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Jalen Coker hits paydirt in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Unfortunately for fantasy managers, Coker was hit with a lost fumble on an errant lateral attempt during the Panthers' last-ditch play of regulation. Still, Coker salvaged what could've been a second straight frustrating performance with a 26-yard TD play in the fourth quarter. The third-year wideout has been inconsistent on a weekly basis to this point, but he's got significant upside each time he takes the field. He's a WR3 in most standard formats.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just one of four targets for nine yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Jalen Coker goes quiet in loss to Tampa
news.impact: Coker was coming in on a hot streak and went ice cold in this game. Everyone has a bad day, and the Carolina offense at large failed to do much at all, so it's not like Coker was the only one on the struggle bus. He will look to have a bounce-back night against the Packers on Thursday.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase hauled in 11-of-14 targets for a whopping 231 yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase racks up whopping 231 yards Sunday
news.impact: Chase was unstoppable on Sunday night. He racked up a whopping 231 receiving yards on 11 catches, which left him with a dominant fantasy total despite the fact that he didn't get into the end zone at all. He is heating up right now after a slightly slow start to the season and is primed to be one of the best players in fantasy over the back half of the year.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 10-of-12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 34-17 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase hauls in 10 passes in Week 9 win
news.impact: Chase led the team in receptions, targets, and receiving yards in the win. Chase and Joe Burrow connected on a 47-yard touchdown to open the scoring. The 26-year-old has found the end zone in four straight games, and will look to continue that streak against the Steelers in Week 10.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 of his 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase goes for 141 yards, TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Chase turned in a huge game in the high-scoring win, although he still finished behind Tee Higgins in receiving yardage on an afternoon where Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards. Chase has scored a touchdown in three straight games, giving him six overall this year. He will be a no-brainer WR1 in fantasy heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Ja’Marr Chase (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 8 for the Cincinnati Bengals according to Paul Dehner Jr.
news.head: Ja’Marr Chase (ankle) off injury report for Week 8
news.impact: Chase is good to go after battling ankle issues earlier in the week, boosting a Cincinnati passing attack for Week 8.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught four of his seven targets for 50 yards in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich in Week 10.
news.head: Jameson Williams goes for 50 yards in Week 10 win
news.impact: Williams finished second on the team in targets in the lopsided win while hitting at least 50 receiving yards for the fourth time over his past six contests. He will be a boom/bust WR3 for fantasy heading into Week 11 vs. the Buccaneers.

news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in one of his two targets for 31 yards while also rushing once for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Jameson Williams sees two touches in Week 9 win
news.impact: Williams was bottled up by an underrated Miami defense, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in his last six games. The wideout will look to return to his explosive form against the New England Patriots in Week 10.

news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in four of his six targets for a team-high 70 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jameson Williams finds end zone in Week 8 win over Vikings
news.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, registering one or more receiving touchdowns in each of his last three games. The wideout remains one of the more explosive offensive options for head coach Dan Campbell entering a juicy Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 5-of-9 targets for 91 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Jameson Williams scores two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: The Lions gave Williams plenty of opportunities on Sunday, and he was able to capitalize on them. He caught two touchdowns and came close to hitting the 100 receiving yards mark, which left him with a terrific fantasy total. He should continue to be viewed as a high-ceiling fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though his floor leaves something to be desired.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 8-of-10 targsts for 171 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba explodes in third quarter Sunday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba entered halftime with just 11 yards before exploding for a huge third quarter that included a 71-yard touchdown reception plus other gains of 30 and 23 yards. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 7-of-10 targets for 51 yards in the Seahawks 17-3 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 'quiet' day Sunday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba was held to his worst performance of the season, but his seven receptions still helped fantasy managers in PPR leagues. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauled in 6-of-11 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba stellar in loss Monday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba was by far Seattle's leading receiver on Monday night, finishing with 92 more yards than their second highest contributor. He was also able to get into the end zone again and finished with a terrific fantasy total, which just adds to the insane pace that he has established over the first half of the season.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught nine of his 12 targets for 150 yards and a touchdown in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauls in TD in Week 7 win
news.impact: Smith-Njigba's crazy production continues as he has at least 100 receiving yards in all but one of his seven games this season while adding eight touchdowns along the way. The star wideout will be a top-three fantasy option heading into Week 8 vs. the Bears on Monday night.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Waddle has logged back-to-back full practices despite remaining in the concussion protocol.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught his only target for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9 with a concussion.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle suffers concussion in Week 9
news.impact: Waddle suffered the injury on a hit from Panthers safety Zakee Wheatley while attempting to make a reception downfield. He was subsequently ruled out for the remainder of the game. Meanwhile, Courtland Sutton saw nine targets, while Pat Bryant caught four passes for 56 yards and a touchdown. Denver enters its Week 10 bye, giving Waddle additional time to clear the concussion protocol before facing the Raiders in Week 11. His availability remains uncertain.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Denver’s game against the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) ruled out for remainder of Sunday
news.impact: Waddle was hit hard while trying to make a leaping grab, and eventually found his way to the medical tent and locker room to be examined for a concussion. Tough break for the talented receiver.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) is questionable to return for the Denver Broncos Sunday according to Zac Stevens.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Waddle headed to the locker room after suffering a hard hit midway through the second quarter, hauling in his only target for 22 yards prior to exiting.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson caught 11-of-13 targets for 80 yards in a 20-17 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson hauls in 11 passes in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Tyson made his season debut last week and immediately saw more playing time in his second career game. There were reports prior to the game that he was working with the first team offense in pregame warmups, and will likely continue to see plenty of targets moving forward. Tyson and the Saints will take on the Bears in Week 11.

news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Jordyn Tyson should get “a healthy dose more” snaps in Week 10 against the Panthers.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson to get 'a healthy dose more' snaps in Week 10
news.impact: Tyson is not on the injury report to begin the week. He will be an upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson caught four of five targets for 30 yards in the Saints' 23-22 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson snags four passes in NFL debut
news.impact: Tyson was second on the team in targets and receptions behind Chris Olave, great for an NFL debut and for coming off of an injury. He should only get better as he gets up to game speed and gets acclimated to the offense.

news.body: Saints WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 9 matchup with the Browns.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) officially active for Week 9
news.impact: Tyson was listed as questionable after being a limited participant in practice this week. Tyson is set to make his debut Sunday, but fantasy managers should not expect to much as the Saints will likely slowly work him into the lineup.

news.body: Josh Downs hauled in four of his five targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Josh Downs finds end zone in Week 10 win
news.impact: Downs took advantage of his first game action since being acquired at the trade deadline, finishing third in targets, receptions, and yards in the win. The wideout offers quarterback Patrick Mahomes another speedy pass-catching option in the Kansas City offense entering a Week 11 contest against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: The Colts are trading wide receiver Josh Downs to the Chiefs.
news.head: Josh Downs traded to Chiefs
news.impact: Downs had requested a trade and now officially gets his request as he joins Patrick Mahomes and Kansas City. The Chiefs were looking to address their wide receiver room and they do so here bringing in Downs. He should be the No. 2 target for Mahomes behind Rashee Rice.

news.body: Josh Downs caught three of his six targets for 24 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Josh Downs goes for 24 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Downs was quiet in what could be his final game with the Colts as trade rumors have popped up surrounding the slot receiver. If Downs ultimately ends up staying in Indy, he will go up against the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.body: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Josh Downs finds the end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Downs was the only Colts player to get into the end zone Sunday, scoring his first touchdown of the season on a six-yard pass from Daniel Jones late in the third quarter. Overall, Downs has mostly been a disappointment for fantasy managers this season. He has caught four or fewer passes in each of the last five games without reaching 50 yards in any of them.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in nine of his team-leading 13 targets for 74 yards in the Vikings' 30-10 Week 10 win over the Packers.
news.head: Justin Jefferson leads pass-catchers in Week 10 win over Packers
news.impact: Jefferson took advantage of the return of quarterback Kirk Cousins behind center, recording over 70 receiving yards for the second time in his last five games. The superstar wideout will look to return to his dynamic WR1 form with more competent quarterback play behind center ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in only 3-of-11 targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Justin Jefferson catches three passes in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Jefferson is one of the league's top talents at wide receiver. Still, the Vikings' inept quarterback play so far this season has turned the All-Pro into an inconsistent, boom-or-bust asset for fantasy managers. Jefferson is in the low-end WR2 discussion at present, but if the Vikings can figure things out at QB, he would fly back up the rankings.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in five of his nine targets for 33 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 8 loss to Lions
news.impact: Jefferson made the most of an otherwise forgettable performance, scoring a touchdown for the second time in four contests despite recording less than 45 receiving yards in three of his last four contests. The wideout has fallen victim to underwhelming quarterback play to this point ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Justin Jefferson caught 4-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Justin Jefferson quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a quiet afternoon for the entire Vikings passing attack. Jefferson will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Lions.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught five of his seven targets for 61 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Keenan Allen catches five passes in Week 10 win
news.impact: Allen was impactful in his first game action since being acquired from the Colts, logging over 60 receiving yards for the third time in his last five contests. The veteran wideout offers head coach Kyle Shanahan another stable pass-catching option as part of an injury-riddled wideout room entering a Week 11 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: The Colts are trading WR Keenan Allen to the 49ers for a 2027 sixth-round pick
news.head: Keenan Allen traded to 49ers
news.impact: With Mike Evans still sidelined and Deebo Samuel working his way back to practice this week, San Francisco adds depth to its wide receiver room with a veteran in Allen. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar unless both Evans and Samuel continue to miss time.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught four of his eight targets for 26 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
news.head: Keenan Allen hauls in four passes in Week 9
news.impact: Allen led the team with his eight targets but wasn't able to do much with the opportunities. The veteran wideout has emerged as one of Daniel Jones' favorite targets this season, catching 40 passes for 351 yards and one touchdown in eight games. Allen will be a flex option in Week 10 vs. the Dolphins.

news.body: Keenan Allen was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Keenan Allen returns to practice on Thursday
news.impact: Allen got a rest day to begin the week on Wednesday. He remains a fringe WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-3 targets for 11 yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Keon Coleman limited to one reception in Week 10
news.impact: Coleman did leave the game temporarily to be evaluated for a head injury. Coleman has seen at least three targets but has failed to do much with them. The 23-year-old will look to bounce back against Miami in Week 11.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Keon Coleman finishes with three receptions Monday night
news.impact: Coleman has had a few strong games this season. He even had a stretch of three straight weeks with a touchdown. Since then, Coleman has managed only four receptions for 21 yards over the last two games. The third-year receiver is just unreliable from a fantasy standpoint.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-3 targets for four yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Keon Coleman held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman saw a major drop off from his six targets last week. With his inconsistent usage this season, fantasy managers should look elsewhere against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 4-of-6 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Keon Coleman leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Coleman stepped up with DJ Moore (shoulder) sidelined for the Bills on Sunday. He led the team with 59 receiving yards against the Raiders, and he was also able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a nice fantasy total on the day. He should continue to be started in most league formats if Moore has to miss additional time beyond this game.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 2-of-3 targets for 26 yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He added 29 rushing yards on three carries.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in two passes in Week 10 win
news.impact: Shakir was one of five Bills' pass catchers to record at least three targets in the win over the Jets. His 26 receiving yards are his lowest since Week 3 against the Chargers. Shakir and the Bills will take on Miami in Week 11.

news.body: Khalil Shakir brought down all four of his targets for 58 yards in Monday's 23-6 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Khalil Shakir leads Bills in receiving Monday night
news.impact: Shakir tied for the team lead in catches and topped the Bills in receiving yards Monday night. Shakir has now caught four or more passes in four of the last five games, averaging 4.6 receptions and 63.6 yards per game in that span.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 5-of-6 targets for 64 yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in five passes in Week 8 win
news.impact: Shakir has seen back-to-back games with at least six targets and has logged at least four receptions in each of those games. Shakir and the Bills will take on a tough Vikings' defense in Week 9.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 4-of-6 targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Khalil Shakir finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Shakir was a bit disappointing as far as yardage goes on Sunday, but he made up for that by scoring one of Buffalo's touchdowns through the air. Still, he isn't a reliable fantasy option at this point, and fantasy managers should be especially wary about starting him whenever DJ Moore (shoulder) is back in the lineup for Buffalo.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell failed to catch his only target in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell puts up goose egg in Week 11
news.impact: After hauling in his first touchdown of the season in Sunday's win, Treadwell got shut out by the Texans' defense on Thursday. The Colts' passing game is simply not one to trust right now, as QB Daniel Jones has struggled to get much of anything going lately.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught all three of his targets for 24 yards and a score in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell snags touchdown in win
news.impact: Treadwell was limited to short area gains in this contest, but made it count with a touchdown. While there could be some potential value in Treadwell, it's hard to make any sort of move for him or any other Colts pass catcher when QB Daniel Jones is playing so poorly.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught just 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell catches just one pass Sunday
news.impact: For the second consecutive week, Treadwell saw just two passes thrown his way. Over those two games, the veteran receiver has only three receptions for 37 yards. At the moment, Treadwell doesn't really register on the fantasy radar. That could change if the Colts, as expected, trade away some offensive pieces.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught two of five targets for 21 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell brings in two passes in loss
news.impact: Treadwell continued his trend of catching fewer than 50% of his targets. He's not a great option for fantasy in any format, failing to produce anything even in a depleted pass-catching room.

news.body: Luther Burden III is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Saints.
news.head: Luther Burden III (concussion) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Burden was able to clear concussion protocol earlier in the week. He remains a borderline WR1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Luther Burden is out of concussion protocol.
news.head: Luther Burden III clears concussion protocol
news.impact: Burden suffered the injury two weeks ago before the Bears bye week. He'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Saints.

news.body: Luther Burden III was practicing on Monday.
news.head: Luther Burden III (concussion) practices Monday
news.impact: Burden left the Bears last game before their bye week with a concussion. He should be good to go, but he'll still need to be monitored in practice.

news.body: Luther Burden III caught seven of his nine targets for 97 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Luther Burden III scores in Week 9, leaves after hit to helmet
news.impact: Burden also took a hit to the head and lost a fumble on the play late in the fourth quarter. He was seen walking slowly to the locker room with a towel over his head shortly after, suggesting a potential concussion. The Bears have their bye in Week 10 before a Week 11 matchup vs. the Saints, giving Burden an extra week to heal up. The budding star wideout has scored a touchdown in each of his past three games for the Bears.

news.body: Makai Lemon hauled in 6-of-9 targets for 61 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Makai Lemon leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The rookie had a solid showing on Sunday. He led the team with 61 receiving yards over the course of the day, though his fantasy total remained limited since he didn't get into the end zone at all. He will continue to be a decent option in PPR leagues for the foreseeable future, even if his week-to-week upside isn't great.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught six of his nine targets for 57 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Makai Lemon draws nine targets in Week 8
news.impact: Lemon led the Eagles in all receiving categories with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both out. The rookie has been productive over his past two contests, going for 124 yards and a touchdown over that span. He will be a flex option in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught 7-of-8 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Makai Lemon plays well in loss Monday
news.impact: The rookie finally had a high-production game, finishing with the most receptions, receiving yards, and touchdowns out of anyone on the team on Monday night. This performance was a good sign that he's not dead in the water after a slow start to the season, but he's unlikely to keep up at this pace when DeVonta Smith (hamstring) makes his return to the lineup.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon caught three passes on six targets for 19 yards in Week 6 against Carolina.
news.head: Makai Lemon inefficient on six targets in Week 6
news.impact: Lemon had a season-high 43 yards in Week 5 but recorded his lowest yardage output since Week 2. With 4.5 yards per target through six games, Lemon has started slowly in his rookie year. With a backup quarterback taking over, the Eagles' offense could continue to struggle.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught three of his four targets for 62 yards in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
news.head: Malachi Fields goes for 62 yards in Week 10
news.impact: Fields finished second on the Giants in receiving in the close loss. The rookie wideout has emerged as a solid big-play threat for the Giants this year, averaging 15.9 yards per catch. Overall, he has 22 catches for 350 yards and one touchdown in nine games. He will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Malachi Fields racks up 40 yards Sunday
news.impact: The rookie was a solid contributor for New York on Sunday, finishing with 40 yards in a win over the Eagles. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to evolve into a trustworthy fantasy asset anytime soon, however.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 4-of-5 targets for 83 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malachi Fields totals 83 yards Sunday
news.impact: Fields recorded a career-best in yardage in the first start with the Giants for J.J. McCarthy. He remains off the fantasy radar for now heading into the Giants bye week.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 2-of-8 targets for 19 yards in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Malachi Fields sees eight targets Sunday
news.impact: Fields was second among Giants wide receivers in targets. It didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught five of his seven targets for 44 yards on Thursday night in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
news.head: Malik Nabers catches five balls in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Nabers finished second on the team in targets and catches, but it was a second straight pedestrian outing for the star wideout. He now has 58 catches for 692 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this season. He will be a low-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 5-of-8 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-11 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Malik Nabers underwhelming in win Sunday
news.impact: Nabers didn't have a great game to his standards on Sunday. He finished with under 50 yards in this win over the Eagles, and he wasn't able to bring in a nice touchdown that would've been the highlight play of the day. He should bounce back and return to form in the very near future, however.

news.body: Malik Nabers was seen catching passes during a walkthrough session for the New York Giants Friday.
news.head: Malik Nabers catching passes Friday
news.impact: Nabers has dealt with unknown issues throughout the practice week for head coach John Harbaugh, but the talented wideout seems poised to take the field barring any serious setbacks ahead of Sunday’s divisional matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles.

news.body: Malik Nabers was seen working off to the side with trainers on Thursday.
news.head: Malik Nabers works off to side with trainers during practice Thursday
news.impact: It is unclear what Nabers is dealing with. He will need to be monitored when the injury report for Thursday is released.

news.body: Malik Washington caught all three of his targets for 50 yards and also threw a 34-yard touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts.
news.head: Malik Washington throws bomb touchdown in loss
news.impact: Washington surprised in this game, throwing a beautiful deep touchdown pass to Jalen Tolbert on a trick play. He finished second on the team in receptions and second in receiving yards on the day, and could be a PPR-flex option next week against the Bills.

news.body: Malik Washington caught two of his three targets for 21 yards while also rushing once for no gain in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
news.head: Malik Washington quiet in Week 9 loss
news.impact: Washington has cooled off in the Miami offense of late, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains another inconsistent option as part of an underperforming Miami offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.body: Malik Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.head: Malik Washington snags touchdown in loss to Patriots
news.impact: Washington had a score in the second quarter to put the Dolphins up by 10, led the team in receptions, and tied for the lead in targets. He's developed into a usable PPR asset this season and should have some utility next week against the Lions' secondary.

news.body: Malik Washington is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Malik Washington (knee) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Washington will remain in the WR4 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Matthew Golden hauled in five of his team-leading nine targets for 70 yards in the Packers' 30-10 Week 10 loss to the Vikings.
news.head: Matthew Golden leads pass-catchers in Week 10 loss to Vikings
news.impact: Golden has been dynamic of late, recording over 70 receiving yards in five of his last six games. The wideout remains one of the few impactful options in an inconsistent Packers offense entering the team's Week 11 bye.

news.body: Matthew Golden hauled in all of his team-leading 10 targets for 164 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 Week 9 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Matthew Golden reaches end zone in Week 9 win over Patriots
news.impact: Golden has been impactful in the Green Bay offense of late, recording over 75 receiving yards in four of his last five contests. The wideout remains one of the more impactful offensive options to this point in the Green Bay offense entering a Week 10 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Matthew Golden caught 7-of-13 targets for 79 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Matthew Golden finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Golden was questionable with shoulder and foot injuries leading into Thursday's game. He didn't seem very bothered by either, however. The first-round selection from 2025 continued his breakout season, setting a new career high with seven receptions against the Panthers' beat-up secondary. Golden also went over 75 yards for the fifth time in eight games this season.

news.body: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) is active for the Packers' game against the Panthers on Thursday night.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) active for TNF against Carolina
news.impact: Golden was initially questionable coming into the contest, but there was optimism that he would play. That turned out to be the case, and he will suit up against the Panthers. He should be started against a defense lacking its top two corners.

news.body: Mike Evans is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Vikings.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) listed questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Evans returned to a limited practice on Thursday. He is trending towards having a chance to return for Sunday night's game against Minnesota.

news.body: Mike Evans was limited in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) limited in practice Thursday
news.impact: Evans made his return to practice. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday heading into Sunday's showdown against the Vikings.

news.body: Mike Evans (Achilles) is participating at San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) participating at practice Thursday
news.impact: Evans has been sidelined for over a month while recovering from an Achilles issue, but he is back at practice on Thursday and is participating in some capacity. He still seems to be a long shot to play in Week 11, but fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the rest of the week.

news.body: 49ers GM John Lynch said “there’s a chance” Mike Evans practices on Thursday.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) 'has a chance' to practice Thursday
news.impact: Evans missed practice on Wednesday to start the week. There should be an update this afternoon on the status of Evans.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Nico Colins scores again in Week 11
news.impact: Collins has now scored in three straight games and is up to six touchdown grabs over eight games this season. C.J. Stroud spread out his passes in this one, so Collins ended up with just a third of Week 10's season-high total in receptions. Still, fantasy managers won't be complaining due to the touchdown. Collins remains a steady WR1.

news.body: Nico Collins hauled in 9-of-16 targets for 94 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Nico Collins grabs nine passes, scores once in Week 10
news.impact: Collins saw more targets on Sunday than in his previous three games combined. The Texans' go-to guy set a new season high in receptions and put up his second-highest yardage total. Collins has now scored in back-to-back games and remains a solid WR1 in standard formats.

news.body: Nico Collins caught four passes for 55 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Nico Collins finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: The star wideout had a solid game on Sunday. He caught four passes for 55 yards and was able to get into the end zone on one of them, which left him with a good fantasy total in this matchup. Fantasy managers should feel solid about his value moving forward, though he may continue to be a bit volatile on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Nico Collins shut down Sunday
news.impact: Collins was completely held in check. He'll look to bounce back off the bye week.

news.body: Parker Washington caught seven of nine targets for 152 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Parker Washington explodes against Titans
news.impact: This was Washington's second 100-yard game of the season and his highest yardage total overall. He was limited to just two catches against Baltimore last time out, failing to corral some targets that should have been caught. However, he made his opportunities count this time around, going nuclear against the Titans' woeful defense. He's right on the edge of WR1/WR2 territory from here on out.

news.body: Parker Washington caught two of seven targets for 61 yards and a score in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
news.head: Parker Washington snags touchdown in win over Ravens
news.impact: Almost all of Washington's fantasy points came on a long 50-yard catch-and-run touchdown in the first half. He failed to bring in anything else after that and suffered some drops as well. It wasn't the greatest game for the talented WR, but it certainly could have been much worse.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 1-of-2 targets for 16 yards and gained 10 yards on one carry in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Parker Washington catches just one pass in Week 8
news.impact: This was not the game fantasy managers expected from Washington on Sunday, but the Jaguars just didn't need to throw the ball much in order to blow out the struggling Colts. Washington's stat lines have been all over the place the last few games, but he is still the top receiving option on a high-powered offense that spreads the ball around.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 4-of-11 targets for 64 yards in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Parker Washington held to four receptions in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Washington led the team in targets, but was unable to do much with them. He finished behind Jakobi Meyers in receptions and receiving yards in the loss, and could not find the end zone despite Trevor Lawrence tossing four touchdowns. Washington will look to rest up in the bye week and bounce back in Week 8.

news.body: Pat Bryant caught four of five targets for 56 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
news.head: Pat Bryant scores touchdown in Week 9
news.impact: Bryant caught a 26-yard touchdown from Bo Nix in the fourth quarter, extending Denver's lead to 26-14. He also led the Broncos in receiving yards. Bryant's five targets matched Evan Engram for second on the team behind Courtland Sutton. With Jaylen Waddle seeing just one target, Bryant's involvement is worth monitoring heading into Denver's Week 10 bye.

news.body: Pat Bryant (ankle) has been activated from injured reserve ahead of Denver’s game against the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Pat Bryant (ankle) activated off of IR
news.impact: Bryant is still officially questionable, but his activation indicates that he will play on Sunday. He’ll be a tough start in his first game back, but could have some flex appeal in later weeks.

news.body: Pat Bryant (ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Pat Bryant (ankle) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Bryant has missed several weeks while on injured reserve, but he was able to practice in full all week and is now considered questionable to make his return on Sunday. He isn't likely to be a strong fantasy option for his first game or two back even if active, but his presence should help QB Bo Nix and Denver's offense as a whole.

news.body: Pat Bryant (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve and will be out for the next four weeks at least.
news.head: Pat Bryant (ankle) placed on injured reserve
news.impact: Bryant recently suffered an ankle injury, and it is serious enough that the team is placing him on short-term injured reserve. That means that he will be sidelined for the next four weeks at least, but it sounds like he's expected to make his return sometime not too long after that. Troy Franklin and Courtland Sutton are both likely to see more work for the Broncos for the foreseeable future in his absence.

news.body: Puka Nacua will undergo MCL surgery and could potentially miss the remainder of the season for the Los Angeles Rams according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Puka Nacua (MCL) could miss remainder of season

news.body: Puka Nacua has been handed a three-game suspension for a violation of the NFL's Personal Conduct Policy, which will be served while he's on injured reserve.
news.head: Puka Nacua receives three-game suspension from NFL
news.impact: Nacua has received a three-game suspension after an NFL review determined that he violated their Personal Conduct Policy. However, he is currently on injured reserve and is several weeks away from being eligible to return, so that suspension will be served while he's on IR, meaning that this suspension won't cause him to miss any more time than he was already set to miss due to injury. Fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next few weeks, as he could be a very valuable asset if he's cleared to play in time for the fantasy playoffs.

news.body: The Rams placed WR Puka Nacua on injured reserve.
news.head: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) placed on IR
news.impact: Nacua will be eligible to return for the Rams’ Week 15 game against the Cowboys. It had been reported that he wasn't expected to be placed on IR, but he wound up landing on it. Nacua suffered PCL and MCL sprains, along with a turf toe injury in Week 10 against the Commanders. His future status remains up in the air.

news.body: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) will not land on injured reserve due to roster logistics, but he is still expected to be sidelined for around 4-6 weeks
news.head: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) won't land on IR, still out for extended time
news.impact: The Rams are not going to place Nacua on injured reserve, not because he will be back sooner than expected, but rather just as a roster management tactic. This is significant for fantasy managers, as he may not be eligible for an IR slot in many league formats as a result of this. That will make him significantly harder to roster for the 4-6 weeks that he's expected to be out.

news.body: Rashee Rice hauled in five of his six targets for a team-leading 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 Week 10 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Rashee Rice leads pass-catchers in Week 10 win over Falcons
news.impact: Rice continues to make the most of sizeable involvement in the Kansas City passing attack, recording five or more receptions in four of his last five games. The wideout remains locked in as a reliable pass-catching option entering a Week 11 matchup against the Arizona Cardinals.

news.body: Rashee Rice (knee) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Rashee Rice (knee) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Rice came into the week with a nagging knee issue of some kind, but it's not a serious issue and he has been fully cleared to play in Week 10. He may see more work in the receiving game if Kansas City's rushing attack is crippled by the potential absence of Kenneth Walker III (groin) this week.

news.body: Rashee Rice is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
news.head: Rashee Rice (knee) practicing in full for Week 10
news.impact: Rice had previously been managing a hamstring injury which appears to be behind him. He'll remain a WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashee Rice caught 5-of-7 targets for 49 yards in a 35-12 win over the Jets.
news.head: Rashee Rice hauls in five passes in Week 9
news.impact: Rice was limited during the week ahead of this game with knee and hamstring injures, but played well and did the most of his opportunities. Rice and the Chiefs will take on the Falcons in Week 10.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught four of his seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 win over the Buccaneers in Week 9.
news.head: Rome Odunze finds the end zone in Week 9 win
news.impact: Odunze found the end zone for the first time all year on a nine-yard pass from Caleb Williams in the first quarter. The veteran wideout has now caught 32 passes for 528 yards in nine games. He will be on bye in Week 10 before taking on the Saints in Week 11.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-6 targets for 87 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Rome Odunze leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Odunze looked good on Monday night. He led the team with 87 yards on four catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a limited fantasy total. He will likely have some boom games here and there moving forward, but it remains difficult to trust starting him on an every-week basis at this point.

news.body: Rome Odunze secured 4-of-5 targets for 69 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Rome Odunze hauls in four passes Thursday night
news.impact: Odunze seems to still be third in the pecking order of Bears pass catchers behind TE Colston Loveland and fellow wideout Luther Burden. Still, Odunze turned in a solid effort Thursday night. Over the last two games with QB Caleb Williams back at the helm of the offense, Odunze has come up with 7-of-9 targets for 108 yards. The third-year pro has 24 receptions with an average of 15.9 yards per catch through seven games.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught three of his four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Rome Odunze quiet in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a sizeable impact in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 50 receiving yards in four of the last five contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust for fantasy managers in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is facing an uncertain timetable to return, per HC Mike Vrabel. When asked about Doubs and when he might come back into the lineup, Vrabel was uncertain and non-commital on a timeline, stating “I’m not sure how long that (his IR stint) will be.”
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) facing uncertain timetable to retun
news.impact: It’s a rough situation for Doubs, who was putting up a big game before going out with a shoulder injury. He’s not droppable jet yet, at least not in leagues with an IR slot. However, he seems to be right on the edge of drop territory, so fantasy managers will need to keep an eye out for any updates regarding his potential return. However, it’s not looking very promising as of writing.

news.body: The Patriots placed Romeo Doubs on injured reserve.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) placed on IR
news.impact: Doubs left Sunday's game early in the third quarter. He will now miss at least the next four games.

news.body: Romeo Doubs caught his lone target for a 42-yard touchdown in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Doubs suffered the injury on the touchdown catch in which he landed hard diving for the ball. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of a Thursday night matchup with the Bears.

news.body: Patriots WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is questionable to return Sunday against the Jets.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) questionable to return
news.impact: Doubs appeared to suffer the shoulder injury on his touchdown reception in the first quarter. The Patriots should update his status after halftime.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught six of his seven targets for 71 yards and one touchdown in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers in Week 10.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy reaches end zone in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Flournoy has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a touchdown in three of his last five contests. The wideout has been one of the more inconsistent pass-catching options in the Dallas offense ahead of a Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught two of his three targets for 53 yards in a 27-23 win over the Colts in Week 9.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy goes for 53 yards in Week 9
news.impact: Flournoy was quiet despite the Cowboys playing without George Pickens (hamstring) in the contest. The veteran wideout has been a solid WR3 for Dallas this season, catching 32 passes for 395 yards and two touchdowns in nine games. He will be on the flex radar against the 49ers in Week 10 if Pickens is unable to suit up.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught three of his four targets for 38 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for three yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy finds end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Flournoy has had a nose for the end zone of late, scoring a touchdown in two of his last three contests. The wideout remains a touchdown dependent option in all formats ahead of a favorable Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught four passes for 70 yards in Monday's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy racks up 70 yards in win Monday
news.impact: Flournoy wasn't heavily targeted on Monday night, but he was able to make the most out of his four opportunities by turning them into four catches for 70 total yards. He isn't fantasy relevant at this point, but he is currently a strong contributor for the Cowboys in real life and worth keeping an eye on if someone ahead of him on the depth chart suffers an injury.

news.body: Stefon Diggs will get a rest day from practice on Thursday.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (rest) will not practice Thursday
news.impact: It is a scheduled day off for Diggs. He should be back at practice on Friday.

news.body: Stefon Diggs caught six of his 10 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10.
news.head: Stefon Diggs goes for 83 yards, TD in Week 10
news.impact: Diggs had his best game of the season in the close win over the Giants on Thursday night. The veteran wideout caught the game-winning touchdown on a 32-yard pass from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left in regulation. Diggs has shown a nose for the end zone in his first season in Washington, catching six touchdowns in eight games. He will be a fantasy WR3 in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Stefon Diggs had three catches for 51 yards in Sunday’s loss to the Rams.
news.head: Stefon Diggs has 51 yards in loss
news.impact: Diggs' 51 yards is his second-highest yardage total of the season. Despite Terry McLaurin's season-ending injury, Diggs' role has remained the same. He will fall in the WR3 range for Thursday's game against the Giants.

news.body: Stefon Diggs caught three of his six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Stefon Diggs finds the end zone in Week 8 win
news.impact: Diggs hauled in an eight-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels in the second quarter. The veteran wideout has been busy in the red zone this season, catching five touchdowns despite only posting 27 receptions in six games. He will be a solid flex option in fantasy in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: Tank Dell secured 3-of-4 targets for 27 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.head: Tank Dell hauls in three passes Thursday night
news.impact: Dell has now caught at least three passes in each of the last three weeks, but his signature big plays have not been there for the most part over the last two games. Still, he has been on the field for just about half of the Texans' offensive snaps over the last three games, and he always has the potential to take one to the house at any point. Dell moves forward as a volatile, big-play receiver for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Tank Dell brought in 3-of-4 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Tank Dell catches three passes in Week 10 loss
news.impact: Dell actually kept the big plays coming Sunday, gaining 29 yards on his first catch of the game. He would bring in two more passes on the day, but both ended up going for negative yardage. Dell is averaging more than 21 yards on his eight grabs over the last three weeks. He's a volatile boom-or-bust fantasy option.

news.body: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Dell will be good to go on Sunday. Neither of his two injuries are serious at this point, and his snaps are expected to continue to increase for a little while as he continues to look great in his return from injury. He may be inconsistent for a while but will have solid week-to-week upside for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Dell was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday due to a pair of injuries. He should be a full go for Week 10 and will look to continue building on the success that he has been having lately.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 5-of-6 targets for 66 yards in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Tee Higgins solid in win Sunday
news.impact: Cincinnati's offense was unstoppable in Sunday night's big win over the Steelers. Higgins wasn't able to fully take advantage of that, however, finishing with five catches for 66 yards over the course of the game.
